1_0_0.content: Wang Xiaoming and his sister Wang Xiaohong decided to explore the Grand Canyon in Arizona, USA. They set off early in the morning on May 12, 2022, and took a plane to Arizona. After arriving at their destination, they rented a car and headed to the Colorado Plateau, where the Grand Canyon is located. They obtained detailed tourist information at the local tourist center and decided to visit the North Caninu Canyon first. They walked along the winding trails and enjoyed the stunning views of the Grand Canyon. In the North Caninu Canyon, they saw towering cliffs and wide and deep canyons, as well as magnificent rock pillars and spiers such as Fairy Peak, Blue Tower and Red Tower. Wang Xiaoming took out his camera and enthusiastically photographed the magnificent scenery of the Grand Canyon. Wang Xiaohong used her mobile phone to record this beautiful moment. Later, they visited the City of the Sun and were attracted by the golden brilliance of the ancient river bed rocks illuminated by the sun. In the Grand Canyon area, they also saw the rapids and waterfalls of the Colorado River, such as Sea Falls and Panther Falls, and felt the majestic momentum of the water. In addition to admiring the scenery, they encountered some rare flora and fauna, such as Canadian snowy owls, mountain lions and California lizards. They camped at a campsite in the Grand Canyon area and watched the beautiful starry sky at night. Wang Xiaoming and Wang Xiaohong had a great time as a family, and they left many wonderful memories in the Grand Canyon.
1_0_0.Theme: Wang Xiaoming and Wang Xiaohong’s family trip

1_0_1.content: Wang Xiaoming's sister, Wang Xiaohong, heard about Luyingju's environmentally friendly home furnishings and was very interested. She decided to invite Wang Xiaoming to visit them. They agreed to visit the exhibition at Green Yingju on October 15, 2022. Wang Xiaoming and Wang Xiaohong admired the environmentally friendly home work called 'Green House' together. During the exhibition, they first entered a living room decorated in a fresh and natural style. Wang Xiaoming pointed to natural materials and green building materials and told Wang Xiaohong that these environmentally friendly materials can protect the environment and at the same time provide healthy and comfortable living spaces. They noticed that the furniture in the living room was made of environmentally friendly boards, such as European environmentally friendly E0-grade boards, which do not contain formaldehyde and other harmful substances. Water-based environmentally friendly materials are also used for dyes and coatings to ensure healthy indoor air quality. In addition, Wang Xiaoming also introduced to Wang Xiaohong the high-efficiency, low-energy-consumption environmentally friendly air-conditioning system adopted by Luyingju. This system uses intelligent temperature control technology to automatically adjust the operating status of the air conditioner according to changes in indoor and outdoor temperature and humidity, optimizing energy consumption and reducing the impact on the environment. There are also green plants in the exhibition. Wang Xiaoming told Wang Xiaohong that green plants can increase the humidity of indoor air, purify the air, and create a healthy and comfortable living environment. Finally, Wang Xiaoming pointed to the solar panels and told Wang Xiaohong that Luyingju's works also use solar power generation systems, which convert solar energy into electrical energy to power lighting and electrical equipment in the home, achieving energy conservation and emission reduction. Wang Xiaohong expressed her appreciation for the design and innovation of these environmentally friendly homes and decided to introduce some environmentally friendly elements into her own home. They had a pleasant time at the exhibition and enhanced mutual understanding and communication.

1_2_0.content: On May 10, 2022, Wang Xiaoming and his romantic partner Li Ting embarked on a wonderful photography trip. They chose picturesque countryside as their location to capture the beauty and serenity of nature. In the morning, they took their favorite cameras and lenses and walked into an ancient village. There they discovered an ancient stone bridge with a crystal clear stream flowing through it. They quickly set up their tripod, adjusted their camera parameters, and began capturing this beautiful scene. Li Ting passionately guided Wang Xiaoming on how to choose the best composition and angle. They carefully capture every detail, from the stones on the bridge to the reflections in the water, and each photo demonstrates their photography talent and sensitivity to beauty. For lunch, they found a local farmhouse and tasted authentic farmhouse dishes. After lunch, they continued walking and came to a large wheat field next to a windmill. Li Ting found an excellent shooting spot in the middle of the wheat field. She lay in the wheat field and took a series of stunning photos from a low angle. Wang Xiaoming stood next to the windmill and captured the magnificent view of the rotating blades and wheat fields. Throughout the afternoon, they traveled through this beautiful countryside, constantly looking for new shooting spots and ideas. In the evening, they came to a high mountain and greeted the afterglow of the setting sun. They stood on the top of the mountain, looking at the mountains and lakes in the distance. This moment seemed to be stuck at the end of time. Together they captured the stunning sunset, and the day's photography trip came to a successful end. This photography trip not only allowed Wang Xiaoming and Li Ting to fully demonstrate their photography skills, but also deepened their relationship. They inspire each other, help each other, and create many beautiful moments together.

1_5_0.content: Wang Xiaoming and his mentor Zhang Wen discussed in depth the applications and challenges of CAR-T cell therapy at a scientific and technological innovation seminar. This discussion took place in the conference room of a well-known technology company in Beijing. Wang Xiaoming showed Zhang Wen cases and works on CAR-T cell therapy, especially his research and improvement results on key steps in CAR-T cell therapy. He mentioned a study he was involved in that used CRISPR gene-editing technology and viral vector-mediated gene transduction to successfully engineer T cells so that they could more effectively recognize and attack cancer cells. Wang Xiaoming also mentioned the remarkable success of CAR-T cell therapy in clinical practice, especially the case of CAR-T cell therapy Kymriah developed by Novartis Pharmaceuticals for the treatment of B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia. Wang Xiaoming and Zhang Wen discussed the challenges that CAR-T cell therapy may face, including immune response and treatment costs. They recognized that CAR-T cell therapy is an important innovative technology in the field of immune system and brings new hope to cancer patients, but it also requires further research and improvement. Zhang Wen expressed appreciation for Wang Xiaoming's research results and encouraged him to continue to conduct in-depth research and explore the potential of CAR-T cell therapy.

2_0_1.content: On May 12, 2022, Li Hua and his brother Li Ming conducted Brownian motion experimental observations. They came to the laboratory and were ready to start the experiment. The laboratory is equipped with microscopes, light sources and other tools to facilitate the observation and recording of the movement of Brownian particles. Li Ming picked up the microscope, adjusted the focus, and prepared to observe the trajectory of Brownian particles in the liquid. Li Hua picked up a pen and paper and prepared to record the position of Brownian particles. At the beginning of the experiment, they recorded the initial position of the Brownian particle, that is, the (x, y, z) coordinates. They then began to observe and record the position changes of the Brownian particles in real time. Through microscope observation, Li Ming could clearly see the irregular movement of Brownian particles in the liquid. Brownian particles constantly collide and diffuse, showing random and irregular movement. By adjusting the focal length of the microscope, Li Ming can observe finer details of movement. Li Hua recorded the position changes of Brownian particles on paper for subsequent analysis and calculation. Through experimental observation and recording, they can obtain rich data. After they take this data home, they can analyze and derive it through mathematical models, and conduct in-depth research on the properties and applications of Brownian motion. This experiment was conducted jointly by Li Hua and Li Ming. They cooperated with each other and jointly completed the task of experimentally observing Brownian particles. As a family, they have a close working relationship, supporting and helping each other.
2_0_1.summary: Observing Brownian particles in the laboratory

2_1_1.content: Li Hua and his college friend Zhang Lei are very good friends. In the summer of 2015, they decided to collaborate on a short artistic film to express their thoughts on social changes in rural China. Li Hua is responsible for filming and directing, while Zhang Lei is responsible for production and post-production. They jointly decided to use the novel 'White Deer Plain' as the inspiration for the short film. Li Hua was deeply moved by the fate and emotions of the characters in the novel, and hoped to convey these stories to the audience through the power of images. Zhang Lei is very interested in the historical background and character relationships in the novel, and hopes to present the complexity of this period of history and the good and evil of human nature through short films. After the filming was completed, they worked together on post-production, including editing, color grading and sound effects processing. This short film has been well received by audiences and critics for its unique artistic expression and profound thinking about human nature, winning more opportunities and recognition for Li Hua and Zhang Lei.

4_1_0.content: Zhang Xiaohong and Wang Li participated in an ethics discussion where the topic was moral chauvinism. During the discussion, Zhang Xiaohong cited the classic case of John Stuart Mill and proposed the importance of individual feelings in moral judgment. She elaborates on the argument made by Mill in Utilitarianism that it is better to be a noble pig than a mean man. Zhang Xiaohong believes that individual feelings should be the basis of moral judgment, because only individuals can feel happiness or pain. Wang Li agreed with Zhang Xiaohong's views and put forward some additional opinions, believing that moral standards should take into account both individual feelings and universally applicable principles. She believes that although individual feelings are important, universally applicable moral principles cannot be completely ignored. Other participants at the discussion also engaged in a heated debate on this topic, each expressing their own opinions. The entire symposium was full of collisions of ideas and an academic atmosphere, providing a good communication platform for ethics research.

4_2_2.content: One day, Zhang Xiaohong and her boyfriend Li Yang spent a pleasant evening together. During the conversation, they talked about the field of developmental psychology, specifically Stanley Milgram’s “obedience experiments.” Zhang Xiaohong was very interested in this experiment, and she asked Li Yang for more details. 6_0_3.content: When Zhao Li and her brother Zhang Ming discussed medicinal chemistry at home, they mentioned the classic example of aspirin. Zhao Li told Zhang Ming that aspirin is an over-the-counter drug that is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) and is widely used in pain relief, fever reduction, and anti-inflammation. She explained that the chemical name of aspirin is acetylsalicylic acid, a derivative of salicylic acid. Zhao Li introduced the molecular structure of aspirin to Zhang Ming, which consists of a benzene ring, an acyl group and a carboxyl group. The chemical formula of acetylsalicylic acid is C9H8O4, and its molecular weight is 180.16 g/mol. She told Zhang Ming that the pharmacological effect of aspirin is based on its inhibitory effect on cyclooxygenase. By combining with cyclooxygenase, it blocks its activity and reduces the occurrence of inflammation and the feeling of pain. In addition, Zhao Li also explained to Zhang Ming that aspirin has anti-platelet aggregation effects and can prevent the formation of thrombosis. They discussed the widespread use of aspirin in the prevention and treatment of cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases. Zhao Li and Zhang Ming were surprised by the importance and widespread use of aspirin, and expressed their great interest in learning medicinal chemistry.

10_2_0.content: Sun Xiaoming and his girlfriend Zhang Li are a pair of ecologists who love nature and environmental protection. They met when they were graduate students and pursued the cause of environmental protection together. On August 15, 2019, they decided to observe the Gammaid meteor shower together. Sun Xiaoming did detailed research in advance and learned that the Gammaid meteor shower was caused by the asteroid 3200 Phaethon, which was discovered by NASA's Gamma Space Telescope. The Gammaid meteor shower is characterized by a relatively slow meteor speed of approximately 35 kilometers per hour, resulting in long and relatively bright meteor trajectories. They chose a place far away from the light pollution of the city, brought photography equipment and hot drinks, and prepared to spend this anticipated night together. That night, they spread out their blankets on a grassy field and looked up at the stars. As night falls, the Gammad meteor shower begins. Meteors pass through the night sky and across the sea of stars, beautiful and spectacular. Sun Xiaoming and Zhang Li took many photos of each other to record this unforgettable moment. During the meteor shower observation process, they not only enjoyed the wonders of nature, but also deepened their feelings for each other. This romantic observation activity strengthened their determination to protect the environment. They hope that through their efforts, more people will realize the preciousness of natural resources and jointly protect our earth home.
10_2_0.summary: Observe the Gammaid Meteor Shower together

profile_description: Xu Hui is a 30-year-old Chinese woman. Her nickname is 'Hui Hui'. Xu Hui is a media and media research expert with extensive knowledge in media research and media analysis. She actively participates in media research projects at home and abroad, and has in-depth research in the field of media and communication. Xu Hui is good at long hair, good at smiling and bright eyes. She loves reading, writing and photography. Her career path has been to publish several academic papers and participate in domestic and international media research projects. Xu Hui's ethnic background is Asian and she has a strong interest in media and communication. She is currently employed at a research institution and has received an Outstanding Dissertation Award. She is a pioneer in media studies.

Together, they read reports on Alibaba's use of artificial intelligence technology and big data analysis to provide consumers with personalized shopping experiences, and discussed Alibaba's cooperation with traditional retailers to create digital upgrades of offline physical stores. 13_1_1.content: Xu Hui and Li Li talked about the latest chromosome research progress at a party. Xu Hui shared her recent research case on human cancer genome. She explained to Li Li that researchers use high-resolution chromosome conformation capture technology to explore the relationship between the three-dimensional structure of chromosomes and cancer development. Xu Hui introduced in detail the researchers' experimental process, which included collecting tumor cell samples from patients with different types of cancer and labeling chromosomes using fluorescence in situ hybridization technology to visualize the location and structure of chromosomes. She also mentioned the application of Hi-C technology, which is a technology that can analyze the spatial structure of chromosomes in the nucleus. Xu Hui told Li Li that through Hi-C technology, researchers can obtain a three-dimensional chromosome structure map of the entire genome, and have discovered chromosome structural abnormalities in certain cancer types during the research process. She cited breast cancer as an example, pointing out that in breast cancer, some key gene regions on chromosomes become closer to each other, which may lead to overexpression or mutation of genes. In addition, she also mentioned the existence of chromosomal rearrangements in cancer cells, which may affect gene expression and regulation. Xu Hui and Li Li were shocked by these findings and discussed the importance of chromosome research in the field of cancer and the new ideas and targets it provides for cancer prevention and treatment. They all believed that this research was of great significance in promoting the development of cancer treatment and expressed their expectation for future research progress.

13_5_2.content: In a robbery case that occurred somewhere, the defendant Li Ming was charged with robbery. On the day of the incident, Li Ming entered a jewelry store at around 2 p.m. and threatened the clerk Wang Xiaomei to hand over the jewelry. Li Ming held a knife and threatened Wang Xiaomei that she must obey his orders, otherwise she would be harmed. Wang Xiaomei handed over jewelry worth 1 million yuan out of concern for her personal safety. The case attracted the attention of local police, who immediately launched an investigation. Through surveillance video, witness testimony and other evidence, investigators confirmed the fact that Li Ming entered the jewelry store on the day of the incident and threatened the clerk with a weapon. The police also discovered through the investigation of Li Ming that he had recorded multiple similar robberies before, and traces of him were also found in the surveillance video around the day of the incident. Based on the above evidence, the public prosecution agency prosecuted Li Ming for robbery. During the trial stage, the court heard the case in accordance with the law. Li Ming's defense lawyer presented his not guilty plea, claiming that Li Ming's facial features could not be clearly identified in the surveillance video and questioned the authenticity of the witness's testimony. However, the prosecution successfully rebutted the defense attorney's challenge by showing the testimony of multiple witnesses and the clarity of surveillance video. After a court hearing, the judge found Li Ming guilty of robbery and, in accordance with Article 263 of the Criminal Law, sentenced Li Ming to ten years in prison and fined him 50,000 yuan. This sentence aims to maintain social fairness and justice and serve as a warning to other potential criminals.

Madan shared the game’s creative process and sources of inspiration, as well as some of the game’s unique designs and features. He also showed the game's trailer and actual gameplay demo to the live audience, which elicited an enthusiastic response. After the press conference, Ma Dan and Jack Ma held a private dinner together to celebrate the successful launch of the game. They reviewed every moment of their growth and shared their expectations and dreams for the future. Jack Ma encouraged Ma Dan to continue working hard in the field of game design and become a better soil scientist and game designer.

The agricultural company is jointly run by Ma Dan and Ma Yun, who are committed to promoting sustainable agricultural development and soil ecosystem protection. As a soil scientist, Madan has in-depth research and understanding of soil protection and utilization. He hopes to contribute to agricultural development through his own efforts. As Ma Dan’s brother and partner, Ma Yun has an in-depth understanding of and participation in the operation and development of agricultural companies. During the visit to the agricultural company, Ma Dan introduced the company's operations, research projects and results to Ma Yun. Together they visited farmlands, greenhouses and laboratories and learned about the company's innovations in agricultural technology, fertilizer utilization and soil protection. Jack Ma expressed his appreciation for the achievements and development of agricultural companies and said that he will continue to support and promote the cause of sustainable agricultural development. The cooperation between Ma Dan and Jack Ma is not only the friendship between brothers, but also the efforts for common goals and ideals. They hope to make greater contributions to agricultural development and soil ecosystem protection through their efforts.

15_1_0.content: In 2010, Ma Dan's college roommate Zhang Wei, an agricultural scientist, invited Ma Dan to visit an art exhibition about 'The Last Supper'. The exhibition was held in a large art gallery and attracted the attention of many art lovers and cultural scholars. Zhang Wei knew that Ma Dan had a strong interest in art, so he specially invited him to go with him. Together they admired the magnificent scene of this mural and were deeply impressed by Leonardo da Vinci's painting skills and artistic conception. During the exhibition, Ma Dan explained the historical background and significance of 'The Last Supper' to Zhang Wei, and shared some interesting details about the work. After the exhibition, they also discussed the impact of their works on the humanities and social fields, and exchanged their unique insights on art. This exhibition became an opportunity for more in-depth communication between Ma Dan and Zhang Wei, deepening their friendship.

15_1_1.content: Ma Dan and his college roommate Zhang Wei decided to participate in the Tomb Sweeping Festival rituals held on the ancient canal in Hangzhou. They got up early in the morning, prepared flowers and offerings, and headed to the dock of the ancient canal. As soon as they arrived at the pier, they saw a huge crowd of people, and tourists boarded the boats to perform sacrificial rituals. On the ship, there are various folk performances and folk artists show off their talents. Ma Dan and Zhang Wei walked along the deck of the ship and enjoyed traditional dragon dance, lion dance and other performances. They held flowers in their hands and threw bouquets into the river to express their thoughts and respect for their deceased relatives. At the same time, they also observed many people holding bouquets of chrysanthemums, peach blossoms, jasmine and other flowers to participate in the sacrificial ceremony. Ma Dan and Zhang Wei also deeply felt the cultural connotation of Chinese traditional festivals and people's affectionate expressions for their loved ones.

15_4_0.content: Ma Dan and Li Jing are colleagues from the Institute of Soil Science. They collaborated on a soil pollution control project on May 12, 2021. As a soil scientist, Ma Dan focuses on studying soil ecosystems, while Li Jing is a soil pollution expert and is good at analyzing and controlling soil pollution. They cooperate very closely, learn from each other and exchange experiences, and work together to solve the problem of soil pollution. As a soil scientist, Ma Dan is responsible for the collection and analysis of soil samples in the project, while Li Jing is responsible for the research and analysis of soil microbial communities. They work closely together, exchange research results with each other, and jointly promote the progress of the project. They meet regularly to discuss research progress and share their research results and findings with each other. During the project, Ma Dan and Li Jing established a good working relationship. They supported and collaborated with each other and worked together to promote soil ecosystem protection. In addition to cooperation at work, Ma Dan and Li Jing have also become good friends. They often discuss topics in work and life together, and share each other's preferences and interests. With their efforts, the 'Soil Ecosystem Protection and Restoration' project has achieved certain results and made a positive contribution to soil protection and sustainable agricultural development.

15_6_0.content: On March 15, 2021, Wang Ming, Madan’s neighbor as a soil scientist, approached him for help. Wang Ming is a farm operator. He recently discovered that the soil quality of his farmland has declined, and crop yields have been greatly affected. Wang Ming was very confused about this and hoped that Ma Dan could provide professional opinions and solutions. Madan accepted Wang Ming's request and went to his farm for an on-site inspection. After detailed soil analysis and observation, Madan discovered that there were problems such as nutrient imbalance and low organic matter content in farmland soil. He had an in-depth exchange with Wang Ming and learned that Wang Ming had not carried out scientific and reasonable fertilization and soil management measures before. Based on his professional knowledge, Madan provided Wang Ming with a detailed soil improvement plan, including suggestions for rational fertilization, increasing organic matter content, and improving soil structure. Wang Ming was very grateful for Madan's help and decided to carry out farmland improvement work according to the plan provided by Madan. After a period of hard work, Wang Ming's farmland soil gradually improved, and crop yields also increased significantly. Wang Ming deeply admired Ma Dan's professional knowledge and help, and the relationship between the two neighbors became closer.

16_0_1.content: On June 15, 2022, Huang Ming, Huang Xin’s brother, improved the stability of drone flight. Huang Ming is a drone enthusiast. He learned about the application of sliding mode control algorithm in drone flight and decided to introduce it into his own drone control system. He modeled the drone using an accurate dynamic model, taking into account factors such as the aircraft's dynamic characteristics, aerodynamic parameters, inertia matrix, and mass distribution. In order to enhance the robustness of the system, he also used an adaptive control strategy so that the control parameters can be automatically adjusted to adapt to the uncertainty of the system model. During the flight, Huang Ming's controller measures the drone's position, speed and attitude information in real time and compares it with the desired trajectory. According to the principle of sliding mode control algorithm, Huang Ming's controller achieves the stability and convergence of the system by introducing sliding mode surfaces. He also used a switching function as an activation function to determine the working mode of the system based on the measurement error of the drone and the slope of the sliding mode surface. By dynamically adjusting the parameters of the switching function, Huang Ming's sliding mode controller is able to achieve fast response, high robustness, and robust stability. Huang Ming's efforts and technical application have significantly improved the flight stability of his drone, which has brought more fun and challenges to his drone hobby. Huang Ming's exploration and practice are not only of great significance in the field of drones, but also provide valuable experience and reference for other fields that require stable and robust control, such as robot navigation, autonomous vehicles, etc.

This is useful in travel, study, Very useful in communication and other scenarios. She also showed Liang Ming the interpreting function of Google Translate, which can translate spoken expressions into the target language in real time and provide two-way voice translation. Liang Ming was very impressed by the multi-lingual capabilities and accuracy of Google Translate, and thanked Liang Xin for answering this question in detail.

After comprehensive weighing, the court finally ruled that mining companies can obtain the right to mine iron ore under certain conditions, but must take strict environmental protection measures and compensate for and repair possible ecological damage. At the same time, the court also required government departments to strengthen the management of natural resources in the area and ensure the sustainable use of resources. 19_0_1.content: In the 1930s, Li Fangfang, as a member of Kong Tingting's family, was very concerned about the harm to the ecosystem. She learned about the case of South American fire ants invading the United States, and was deeply aware of the threat and complexity of this species invasion to the ecosystem. Li Fangfang and Kong Tingting studied the detailed description of this case together and learned that South American fire ants were first transported on cargo ships in Louisiana, USA, via refrigerated goods. After fire ants escape, they multiply and spread rapidly in the local ecosystem, posing a threat to other insects, small vertebrates and humans. Fire ant stings cause severe pain, skin inflammation, and can lead to severe allergic reactions and death. The expansion of fire ants has caused serious damage to local ecosystems, with many native animal populations drastically reduced and even some species becoming extinct. Especially for ground-nesting birds and mammals, fire ants cause tremendous pressure, putting their breeding and foraging environments at great risk. In response to fire ant invasion, governments at all levels in the United States have taken a variety of measures, including strengthening entry inspections, regular inspections, and spraying of termiticides. In addition, scientists are also conducting long-term research in the hope of finding a more effective method of killing ants, including the use of natural enemies of fire ants, biological control measures, and gene editing technologies. Li Fangfang believes that this case has attracted widespread attention from the international community, prompting countries to strengthen the monitoring and management of invasive species. She encouraged scientists to delve deeper into ecology and biodiversity conservation in order to reduce the occurrence of similar invasion events and protect the sustainable development of the natural environment.
19_0_1.Theme: South American fire ants invade the United States

20_6_0.content: On March 15, 2022, Yang Lei and Peng Jie studied an interesting calculus application case together as neighbors. As an agricultural educator, Peng Jie has in-depth research on growing crops and agricultural technology, while Yang Lei has a strong interest in mathematics and physics. Together they discussed a practical problem about finding the extreme value of a function, that is, how to maximize the area of a rectangular field when the length of the fence is known. Peng Jie used the knowledge of calculus to help Yang Lei establish relevant mathematical models and equations, and explained how to find the length and width of a rectangle by solving equations and judging extreme points. In the specific case, they assumed that the length of the fence was 10 meters and 15 meters respectively. Through calculation, they found that the length and width of the rectangle enclosing the largest area were 5 meters and 7.5 meters respectively, and the corresponding area was 37.5 square meters. Through this case, Peng Jie showed Yang Lei the importance and widespread application of calculus in solving problems in real life. This research allowed Peng Jie and Yang Lei to deepen their friendship with each other, and they gained a deeper understanding of the application of calculus.

22_1_0.content: Feng Wei and his college roommate Zhang Lei once had an unforgettable travel adventure together. They chose Malaysia as their destination. This tropical country not only has beautiful beaches and rich natural landscapes, but also has the charm of multiculturalism. Together they explored Malaysia’s natural beauty, including a visit to the Sena Canopy Walk, one of the world’s oldest rainforests. In this spectacular forest, they witnessed a variety of strange animals and plants, and felt the magic and grandeur of nature. In addition to exploring nature, Feng Wei and Zhang Lei also immersed themselves in Malaysian culture. They tasted local delicacies and enjoyed traditional dance and music performances. During a cultural experience event, they also met a local folk dancer and learned some basic steps of traditional dance from her. During the trip, Feng Wei and Zhang Lei supported each other and shared many laughing and exciting moments. They climbed mountains together, explored on foot, and even took on the thrilling rafting project together. These adventures brought them closer together and became real good friends. Feng Wei and Zhang Lei’s travel adventures not only enriched their life experiences, but also deepened their understanding of cultural diversity and climate change issues in Asia. The knowledge and experience of this trip played a positive role in promoting Feng Wei’s academic background and practical experience in climate change research, and also provided him with new thinking and vision for his future academic work.
22_1_0.Theme: Feng Wei and Zhang Lei’s travel adventure

22_1_1.content: In 1989, Feng Wei and his roommate Zhang Lei participated in the observation of Neptune's atmosphere. As a scientist and research expert, Feng Wei is very enthusiastic about this mission and views observing Neptune as an adventure and challenge. Feng Wei and Zhang Lei carried the observation data of the Voyager 2 detector and conducted detailed analysis and research. They carefully studied information about various named entities in Neptune's atmosphere, such as atmospheric bands, subhalos, gas gaps, and dark hurricanes. During their research, they discovered some interesting phenomena and features, and the data provide important clues to understanding Neptune's climate and atmospheric activity. They also noticed that there are large amounts of elements such as deuterium and helium III in Neptune's atmosphere. These components provide important references for the study of the evolution and origin of the solar system. Through cooperation and hard work, Feng Wei and Zhang Lei made their observations accurately recorded and published, making important contributions to the field of astronomy. Their work not only deepened people's understanding of Neptune, but also promoted the research and exploration of solar system objects.

22_1_2.content: In 2010, Feng Wei and his college roommate Zhang Lei embarked on a thrilling adventure together. They decided to go to Tibet, China, to pursue the miracle of glaciers on the snowy plateau. This trip was not only to satisfy their passion for adventure, but also to witness firsthand the impact of global climate change on this fragile environment. Feng Wei and Zhang Lei encountered many difficulties and challenges during their adventure. They had to trek dozens of kilometers of steep mountain roads, cross glaciers and tundra zones, and even encountered snowstorms and hypoxia at high altitudes. However, their determination and love for scientific research enabled them to overcome all difficulties. During this journey, Feng Wei and Zhang Lei witnessed melting glaciers, landslides and other phenomena. They used their cameras to record precious photos and video materials, making important contributions to subsequent research work. In the process of pursuing the miracle of glaciers, Feng Wei and Zhang Lei also deepened their friendship and became friends who talked about everything. After returning to university, Feng Wei compiled their adventure stories and research results into an academic paper, which was published in the International Journal of Climate Change Research. This paper is important for deepening understanding of climate change and alpine ecosystems. Feng Wei received praise from the scientific community and was nominated for the Al Gold Award. This adventure trip became a precious memory in their lives and laid a solid foundation for their future scientific research work.

Feng Wei is very interested in the combination of music and urban planning, while Wang Li admires Feng Wei's climate change research work. Therefore, after the meeting, they decided to work together on a musical city planning project called 'The Harmonious Sound of the City'. Wang Li served as the urban planner for the project and was responsible for working closely with local acoustic engineers, architectural designers and Feng Wei to ensure that the design of the musical fountain matched the acoustic characteristics of the city. During the project, Feng Wei and Wang Li inspired each other, and through joint efforts, they successfully realized the creative concept of the musical fountain. Feng Wei is responsible for providing scientific support and professional advice, while Wang Li uses her rich urban planning experience and creativity to skillfully integrate musical elements into urban architecture and environment. In the end, their efforts paid off, and the Music City Planning Project was officially completed and opened to the public on May 15, 2019. The musical fountain of 'The Harmonious Sound of the City' has become a popular attraction for citizens, bringing them a unique urban experience. At the same time, this project also brings economic benefits to the city and contributes to the development of culture and art. During the cooperation process, Feng Wei and Wang Li not only enhanced each other's understanding and feelings, but also jointly created a wonderful and harmonious urban environment.

Feng Wei and Zhao Gang have established a close cooperative relationship over the past many years, and they have jointly published a number of important research papers on climate change. Zhao Gang is a scientist with rich data analysis skills and a profound academic background. His contributions have made the research project more comprehensive and accurate. Through continuous discussions and mutual collaboration, Feng Wei and Zhao Gang gradually advanced this research project and won a good reputation in the academic world. 22_4_1.content: Feng Wei collaborated with his colleague Zhao Gang on the structural engineering design of a skyscraper. The skyscraper is a project undertaken by world-renowned architects Davis Design. The building site is located in a busy business district, adjacent to several major transportation hubs and metro stations. In order to ensure the stability and safety of the building, Feng Wei and Zhao Gang used their expertise in climate change research to participate in key designs such as wind analysis, seismic analysis and foundation treatment of the building. They combined wind tunnel test data and advanced calculation methods to determine the wind resistance and seismic performance of the building, and carried out structural optimization design. During the construction process, Feng Wei and Zhao Gang used their advanced construction technology and equipment to assist the construction team in carrying out construction according to detailed construction plans and methods. They ensure precise installation of the structure and controllable construction quality. In this case, Feng Wei, as the protagonist, demonstrated his professional knowledge and abilities in the field of structural engineering as a climate change research expert, and worked closely with Zhao Gang as a colleague to jointly promote the construction of skyscrapers.

22_4_2.content: During the research process, Feng Wei and Zhao Gang jointly designed methods to collect ant population data and tree growth indicators. Feng Wei is responsible for regularly monitoring the number and diversity of ants in multiple forest sample points using ant samplers, while Zhao Gang is responsible for collecting and analyzing data on various growth indicators, pests and diseases, and drainage conditions of trees. Together, they analyzed the ants' activity areas, breeding status, and relationships with trees. The research team found that ants play an important role in the Amazon rainforest ecosystem, both as natural enemies of trees and as seed dispersers. They jointly studied and verified that the seed dispersal ability of different trees is affected by ant activities, and found that different types of ants play different roles in seed dispersal. Zhao Gang's research results support Feng Wei's previously published research results on animal diversity and functional diversity in the Amazon rainforest. Their research results have important guiding significance for protecting and managing the Amazon rainforest ecosystem and promoting sustainable development.

25_0_2.content: In 1963, Cao Ming participated as a participant in an experiment conducted by Stanley Milova. This experiment is a study on obedience and moral choices, and Cao Ming was assigned to play the role of a teacher. In the experiment, Cao Ming was told that learners needed to be taught a series of words and tested. Every time the learner answered incorrectly, Cao Ming was asked to give an electric shock stimulus. However, in reality, the learner was an actor colluding with the experimenter and did not actually receive the shocks. The experimenter encouraged Cao Ming to continue giving electric shock stimulation through verbal instructions, even though Cao Ming could feel the learner's painful moans. During the experiment, Cao Ming felt uneasy and morally entangled, but still found it difficult to resist the experimenter's orders. This experiment triggered Cao Ming's thinking about individual responsibility and the power of individual will, and also exposed the impact of group pressure and obedience to authority on individual behavior.

Zhang Jing's skin instantly became smooth and flawless, and her skin tone became more even and brighter. They all lamented the light texture and natural look of this foundation, which blended perfectly into the skin without feeling heavy. After the trial, both Cao Lili and Zhang Jing were full of praise for this liquid foundation and decided to buy it and make it a must-have for daily makeup.

Zhang Ming added that social media also provides channels for obtaining intelligence and strategic insights, which is of great significance to military intelligence work. They decided to work together on a study to explore how social media data analysis and psychological principles could be used to aid military strategy development and execution. Lu Yun and Zhang Ming used big data analysis and social network analysis methods to study virtual warfare and information warfare on the battlefield, and explored the potential impact of social media on war operations. They analyzed cases from past conflicts, such as the crisis in Ukraine and conflicts in the Middle East, as well as the online propaganda and recruitment activities of terrorist groups. Through this research, they discovered the potential and challenges of social media in strategic propaganda, psychological warfare and cyber warfare. Their research results were published at the International Military Strategy Symposium and attracted widespread attention and discussion among the participants. Their research provides new perspectives for military strategic analysis and a deeper understanding of information and psychological warfare on the battlefield.

26_3_1.content: In a certain case, Li Hua, as the buyer, and Zhang, as the seller, signed a house sales contract. The contract stipulates that Zhang will transfer a property under his name in Chaoyang District, Beijing, to Li Hua for a price of 1 million yuan, and promises that the house will not be subject to any property rights disputes such as pledge, seizure, and freezing. The transaction completion time stipulated in the contract is within one month after the contract is signed. However, on the eve of the completion of the transaction, Li Hua learned through an equity investigation that the property was in litigation. The original owner, Yang, sued the court for breach of contract and requested to terminate the property transaction contract. Therefore, Li Hua immediately informed Zhang of the situation and requested to terminate the contract and return the purchase price. After investigation, the court confirmed that the property was indeed sued by the original owner, Mr. Yang, and issued a decision to seal and freeze it. According to relevant legal provisions, the house may not be transferred during the period of seizure. Because Zhang deliberately concealed the lawsuit and seizure of the house, Li Hua filed a breach of contract lawsuit with the court and requested the return of the purchase price and corresponding liquidated damages. The court found that Zhang deliberately concealed important information and violated the seller's true disclosure obligation in the sales contract, and ruled that Zhang was responsible for returning the purchase price and paying liquidated damages. According to legal provisions, Li Hua has the right to terminate the sales contract, return the house and demand compensation for economic losses. This case highlights the obligation of true disclosure in the sales contract, which plays an important role in safeguarding the legitimate rights and interests of the buyer.

31_0_0.content: In 2017, a constitutional dispute involving freedom of speech occurred in a certain country. A citizen posted a comment about government corruption on social media, causing dissatisfaction with the government. The government considered the article malicious and defamatory and damaged its image, so it took the citizen to the Constitutional Court. When the Constitutional Court considered the case, it noted that freedom of speech, as an important part of civil rights, should receive special protection. The court noted that the citizen did not use malicious words of personal attack in his speech, but only expressed his personal views through criticism, and believed that this was a legitimate way to exercise his right to freedom of speech. However, the government alleged that the citizen's speech involved intimidation. After detailed analysis, the court held that the citizen did not spread violence or create social unrest through malicious speech. Although the content of the speech was highly critical, it did not reach the level of intimidation. During the court hearing, the Constitutional Court reviewed the process of relevant legal legislation to ensure the constitutionality of the law. Ultimately, the court ruled that the citizen's speech did not violate the provisions of the Constitution on freedom of speech and civil rights, and therefore the citizen should not be restricted or punished by law. However, during the course of this case, Xiong Yan, as Xiong Fei's sister, was also threatened. Due to her relationship with Xiong Fei, she was harassed and maliciously attacked by some people. Although Xiong Yan was not involved in Xiong Fei's speech case, she was involved and became the focus of public opinion. This case demonstrates the important role of the Constitutional Court in upholding civil rights and protecting freedom of speech, and also reveals the possible ripple effects behind freedom of speech.

42_0_0.content: Gong Lei was interested in specific cases in the field of social media and online trust. She heard about the Facebook social media platform’s transparency program and asked her sister Gong Lin about the program. Gong Lin enthusiastically explained the details of the transparency plan. She told Gong Lei that the goal of the transparency plan is to increase users' trust in information on the Facebook platform. She detailed two major measures in the plan, the Advertising Library and the Political Advertising Transparency Report. Gong Lin explained that the advertising library function enables users to view all advertisements posted on the platform and their sponsors, so that users can clearly understand the source and sponsor of the advertisements and enhance the transparency of advertisements. The Political Advertising Transparency Report provides detailed information on political advertising placement, expenditure amounts, and audience demographics, allowing users to more fully understand the source and impact of political advertising. Gong Lin also mentioned that Facebook strictly scrutinizes advertisers and requires advertisers to verify their identities and advertising purposes to reduce the spread of false advertising. In addition, Facebook also uses machine learning and artificial intelligence technology to identify and filter fake news, untrue remarks and other content to improve users' trust in content on the platform. Gong Lei listened with great interest, expressed appreciation for the measures of the transparency plan, and decided to actively advocate the importance of transparency and trust building in her own work. The sisters discussed how to apply these concepts to the education and medical industries, hoping to contribute to the development of these fields. They are emotional and hope that the success of the Transparency Initiative will lead to a safer and more secure future for social media and online communication.

42_2_0.content: Gong Lin and her boyfriend Zhang Ming plan to travel to Russia together in the summer of 2019 to explore this country full of history. As an educational consultant, Gong Lin is interested in history, while Zhang Ming is a photographer who loves photography. They hope to record the footprints of important historical events such as the Russian October Revolution through travel and photography, and to feel the charm of this period of history. They plan to start their journey in St. Petersburg, a city that was an important site of the Russian October Revolution. In St. Petersburg, Gong Lin and Zhang Ming visited the historical sites of the Petrograd Uprising, including the Winter Palace and the Telegraph Office. They followed the footsteps of historical figures such as Lenin and Trotsky and learned about the process of the uprising and the victory of the Bolshevik Party. While exploring, they met an enthusiastic tour guide who explained in detail what it was like during the uprising and shared some interesting stories about it. Gong Lin and Zhang Ming took many photos together to record this important historical moment. During their journey, they also visited other places associated with Russian history, such as the Kremlin and Red Square. Their travels not only enriched their knowledge, but also enhanced their relationship. After returning to China, they reviewed the photos of the trip together and made wonderful memories.

44_4_1.content: In a hospital in a certain city, Zhai Xiaolei and his colleague Liu Tao used the most advanced otolaryngology technology to successfully treat a patient with nasopharyngeal cancer. The patient, surnamed Zhang, is 45 years old and has symptoms such as hoarseness, cough, and runny nose. The symptoms have been getting worse for half a year. Zhai Xiaolei and Liu Tao conducted a preliminary examination and found an obvious mass in Mr. Zhang's throat. In order to confirm the diagnosis, they decided to conduct further examinations for Mr. Zhang. First, they used nasopharyngoscopy to examine Mr. Zhang's throat and found an abnormal mass. Next, they decided to perform a nasopharyngoscopic resection, where the mass was removed and a biopsy sample was taken for pathological examination. Pathological examination showed that the mass was nasopharyngeal carcinoma and had spread to surrounding tissues of the throat. After comprehensive evaluation, Zhai Xiaolei and Liu Tao decided to adopt a treatment plan of fractionated radiotherapy and chemotherapy. 45_3_0.content: Mo Xiulan and Wang Ming met at a high school reunion and talked about medicinal chemistry in the field of chemistry. As a mature and steady man, Wang Ming likes reading and fitness, and he also has a certain understanding of the medical field. He noticed that Mo Xiulan was a creative writing writer with a deep understanding of Asian cultural background and an educational background in creative writing. Therefore, Wang Ming decided to discuss a drug called dabrafenib with Mo Xiulan. They discuss the background to the development and mechanism of action of dabrafenib. Wang Ming learned that dabrafenib is a broad-spectrum tyrosine kinase inhibitor mainly used to treat malignant melanoma. He introduced to Mo Xiulan that malignant melanoma is a serious type of skin cancer, and BRAF gene mutation is one of the main causes of this cancer. The molecular structure of dabrafenib has been carefully designed to be highly selective and can target and inhibit mutant BRAF protein kinase. They discussed in depth that dabrafenib binds to the mutant BRAF protein, blocking the activity of BRAF kinase, thereby preventing the growth and spread of malignant melanoma cells. According to the results of clinical trials, dabrafenib can significantly improve the survival rate and quality of life of patients with malignant melanoma. In addition, they mentioned that dabrafenib also has potential in the treatment of some other types of cancer. However, Wang Ming also told Mo Xiulan that dabrafenib, as a molecular targeted drug, has some side effects in clinical application, such as fever, skin lesions, and joint pain. They agreed that use of the drug requires close monitoring and management by physicians. Finally, they jointly lamented that drug development and clinical application require the efforts of a large number of scientific researchers, and the successful development of dabrafenib is also inseparable from interdisciplinary cooperation among experts in the fields of chemistry, biology, and medicine. They all believe that dabrafenib, as a drug for the treatment of malignant melanoma, is of great significance in the field of medicinal chemistry and brings hope to patients suffering from this cancer.

45_4_2.content: In this case, Mo Xiulan and her smart and witty young female colleague Chen Si worked together to study the influencing factors and changing patterns of dissolved oxygen in water. They selected water samples from different sources, including rivers, lakes, groundwater and seawater. To ensure the accuracy of the study, they collected multiple samples and used standardized experimental methods to measure dissolved oxygen in the samples. During the experiment, Mo Xiulan and Chen Si noticed that factors such as the temperature, salinity and climate conditions of the water body would affect the concentration of dissolved oxygen in the water. Therefore, when measuring dissolved oxygen content, they also recorded the temperature, salinity and climate data of the water body to build corresponding models. They found significant differences in dissolved oxygen levels between water types. The dissolved oxygen content in river water is usually high, the dissolved oxygen content in lakes is low, the dissolved oxygen content in groundwater is relatively stable and high, and the dissolved oxygen content in seawater is closely related to factors such as temperature and salinity in the ocean. The research results of Mo Xiulan and Chen Si provide important reference and guidance for understanding and predicting changes in dissolved oxygen in water bodies.

Wang Qiang: Sister Yao Min, I really learned a lot from this lecture. I now understand more about parallel universes and multi-world explanations. Thank you for hosting such an interesting lecture with your friends.

50_0_0.content: On June 15, 2022, Jiang Bo’s wife Jiang Jing visited the artist Maria’s “Healing Dance” exhibition. When she entered the exhibition hall, she was attracted by the bright and gradient colors behind the works. The air of the exhibition is filled with a warm and cheerful atmosphere, as if the viewer has entered a meadow and feels the tranquility and natural atmosphere. Jiang Jing's eyes focused on the flying human figure in the center of the work. This figure demonstrates strength and hope, conveying a sense of energy and joy through her flowing lines and rich colors. She is particularly fond of the flowers and botanical elements in the paintings, which symbolize the ability to heal and grow. Maria painted different kinds of flowers, such as tulips, sunflowers and roses, each with a specific meaning. Jiang Jing was deeply moved by the healing power of psychotherapy conveyed in this work, and she was inspired to find the path to inner self and emotional healing. After visiting the exhibition, Jiang Jing decided to share this soul-touching experience with Jiang Bo, hoping to bring him some artistic inspiration and motivation.

51_0_0.content: On March 10, 2022, Wan Jianhua and his wife Wang Xiaohong embarked on the journey to Mount Everest together. As an expert in human rights law, Wan Jianhua has always had a strong interest in earth science and environmental protection, and Wang Xiaohong, as his wife, also supports and encourages his research and practice. They decided to experience the majestic scenery of Mount Everest firsthand in order to better understand the impact of geological structures on human society and the ecological environment. They arrived at the south slope of Mount Everest on the morning of March 10 and climbed along the steep mountain road to the summit. During the mountain climbing process, Wan Jianhua and Wang Xiaohong learned some important features of the geological structure of Mount Everest by observing the mountain and surrounding landforms. They noted the presence of multiple geological faults and fold structures near the mountains, which are the result of tectonic movements between tectonic plates. Wan Jianhua specifically pointed out the Sakuma Pass fault on the north slope of the peak, which is a north-sloping crustal fault. In addition to geological faults and fold structures, they also noted that Everest's geological structure was affected by glacial activity. Cold climate conditions at high altitudes lead to the formation of large amounts of snow and glaciers. These glaciers cause pressure and friction on the earth's crust during their movement, further affecting the evolution of geological structures. Wan Jianhua and Wang Xiaohong carefully observed the snow and glaciers on the peak and felt their continuously changing energy. This trip to Mount Everest gave Wan Jianhua and Wang Xiaohong a deeper understanding of the earth's geological structure and evolution process, and further consolidated their concern for environmental protection and sustainable development. After returning to the law firm, Wan Jianhua will continue to provide legal support for cases in the field of human rights law, while Wang Xiaohong will also actively participate in social welfare activities to jointly promote social progress and the protection of human rights.

This award is not only Wang Xiaohong’s personal success, but also Xiao Zhang’s pride as a class teacher.

51_0_2.content: The wife of partner Wan Jianhua is also a lawyer in a law firm, specializing in the field of linguistics. She was very interested in John Dewey's essay 'Language Without Borders: Asha and the Code of Jurassic War' and read and commented on it in detail. In her comments, Wang Xiaohong mentioned the importance of John Dewey's research on the Asha language and believed that the paper was of landmark significance in the field of linguistics. She pointed out that Dewey obtained valuable information about the Jurassic Wars by deciphering the ancient language Asha, which promoted the development of ancient language research and linguistics. In addition, Wang Xiaohong also gave a positive evaluation of Dewey's research methods and the logical structure of the paper, and believed that his interpretation was reasonable and reliable. Wan Jianhua and Wang Xiaohong often discuss professional issues, and their interactions promote academic growth and exchanges between both parties.
51_0_2.Theme: Language Without Borders: Asa and the Code of the Jurassic War

51_1_0.content: In college, Wan Jianhua became good friends with his friend Li Ming and often traveled together. Li Ming is a pharmacist who works in a pharmacy with specific functions. As an expert in human rights law, Wan Jianhua is very interested in cases in various fields, including analytical chemistry in the field of chemistry. During one of their trips together, Wan Jianhua told Li Ming a famous case about the application of gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS) in criminal investigations. Wan Jianhua told Li Ming that this technology can be used to identify and analyze various compounds, and is particularly effective when analyzing a criminal case. He described a case to Li Ming in which an investigation team successfully analyzed drugs left on the victim by a suspect by using GC-MS technology. Wan Jianhua explained the principles of the technology in detail, from sampling to gas chromatography separation to mass spectrometry identification. He told Li Ming that in this case, investigators determined through GC-MS analysis that the organic compound on the victim was benzimidazolin, a compound with anesthetic effects. Wan Jianhua also told Li Ming that in order to confirm that the crime suspect was related to the local pharmacist, the investigators analyzed the items in the pharmacist's office through the identification of characteristic peaks by GC-MS. Ultimately, investigators determined that the benzimidazolin originated from the pharmacist's work environment, further supporting speculation that the pharmacist was involved in the crime. After hearing this, Li Ming was very interested in GC-MS technology and its application in criminal investigation. He discussed more content in the field of analytical chemistry with Wan Jianhua, and expressed his concern for fairness and justice, saying that as a As a pharmacist, he will pay more attention to professional ethics to ensure that he is not exploited in illegal activities. This case not only deepened the friendship between Wan Jianhua and Li Ming, but also prompted them to continue to explore more topics related to human rights and legal fields during their travels.
51_1_0.Theme: Pharmacist Crime in Analytical Chemistry Cases

51_2_2.content: On May 20, 2021, Wan Jianhua and his girlfriend Zhang Meili participated in a yoga meditation activity held at Fukuzawa Temple in Omotoyama, Japan. As an expert in human rights law, Wan Jianhua has been committed to seeking inner peace and wisdom. As his partner, Zhang Meili is also full of interest and curiosity in the spiritual practice of meditation. Fukuzawa-ji Temple is one of Japan's most important Zen meditation sites for the Soto sect, attracting practitioners from all over the world. This meditation event brought together groups of Zen monks and students from Japan and other countries. At the beginning of the event, the practitioners took off their shoes at the entrance of the temple and made offerings to express their respect for Buddhism and Fukuzawa Temple. Wan Jianhua and Zhang Meili followed in the footsteps of other practitioners and entered the temple. In the preparation stage of meditation, the meditating monk will guide the practitioner to sit upright and adjust his breathing to bring the body and mind into a relaxed state. Wan Jianhua and Zhang Meili sat together quietly, trying to block out external interference and focus on their inner world. During meditation, senior meditation monks in the temple hold regular talks to answer questions from practitioners and provide teachings and advice on the path of meditation. This was a very valuable opportunity for Wan Jianhua and Zhang Meili. Through listening and interacting, they gained a deeper understanding and insights. In addition, the meditators also studied some classics and documents, such as the 'Prajna Paramita Heart Sutra' and 'The Five Patriarchs of Zen's Heart Points Directly to the Essential Points of the Human Heart' to explore the wisdom of Buddhism. Wan Jianhua and Zhang Meili are full of interest in the study of these classics, and actively communicate and share their experiences with other practitioners. After a period of persistent practice, Wan Jianhua and Zhang Meili gradually experienced the physical and mental peace and relief brought by meditation, and their spiritual vision became broader. From the Zen meditation activities at Fukuzawa Temple, they gained the wisdom of balance and deep insight into themselves and things. Participating in Fuze Temple yoga meditation activities has allowed Wan Jianhua and Zhang Meili to grow and develop mentally and spiritually. The experience also strengthened their bond and deepened their relationship as romantic partners.

58_1_0.content: In the fall of 2010, Shi Haiyan and Li Hua became good friends in college. They share a common interest in astronomy and often discuss and learn related knowledge together. Once, they heard about the construction of the European Southern Observatory (ESO) ALMA Observatory in Chile and were very interested in it. So, they decided to go to Chile together to visit the ALMA Observatory. Shi Haiyan and Li Hua came to the ALMA Observatory in the Atacama Desert of Chile and were shocked by the magnificent sight before them. They learned that ALMA is one of the largest and most sensitive radio telescope arrays in the world, consisting of 66 12-meter-diameter radio antennas. The observatory is located on a thousand-meter plateau about 5,000 meters above sea level, so it can avoid the impact of clouds and atmospheric pollution on observations. Shi Haiyan and Li Hua visited various parts of the ALMA Observatory under the guidance of a tour guide. They saw the huge scale and precision craftsmanship of the antenna, and deeply lamented the greatness of human technology. The tour guide also introduced them to ALMA’s observation principles and research fields in detail. In the specific observation case of ALMA, the tour guide told them about the observation of an interstellar molecular cloud called 'Alma 22'. This interstellar molecular cloud is about 1,000 light-years away from Earth and is thought to be a place where new stars are forming. Shi Haiyan and Li Hua listened with great interest and learned deeply about how ALMA studies the birth process of stars by observing radio signals in molecular clouds. Shi Haiyan and Li Hua also visited the data center of the ALMA Observatory and learned about the storage and processing of observation data. They were surprised to learn that the data observed by ALMA required more than 4 petabytes of storage capacity to store and analyze. Analysis of these data can provide scientists with important information about interstellar molecular clouds. This visit gave Shi Haiyan and Li Hua a deeper understanding of the importance of the ALMA Observatory and radio observations. They were attracted by the infinite charm of astronomy and determined to make their own contributions in related fields in the future. This experience also made the friendship between Shi Haiyan and Li Hua stronger, and they spent many happy times together pursuing their scientific dreams.

58_4_1.content: In a certain business transaction, Company A and Company B reached a business cooperation agreement. According to the agreement, Company A will provide Product A and sell it to Company B, and Company B will purchase Product A at a fixed price and promote and sell it. Both parties agreed to share sales profits at a 50% share. However, after a few months of cooperation, Company A discovered that Company B did not purchase Product A at the price stipulated in the contract, but made large purchases at a lower price, thereby obtaining high sales profits. Company A is dissatisfied with this and believes that Company B's behavior violates the contract. Therefore, Company A decided to take legal action to safeguard its rights and interests. Company A hired a well-known law firm with extensive experience in the field of commercial law. Through careful study of the agreement and investigation of the actual behavior of both parties, the legal team confirmed Company A's accusations and found a large amount of evidence to support its claims. During the process of preparing litigation materials, the legal team discovered that Company B had engaged in similar cooperation with other suppliers and had been accused of similar breaches of contract by many companies. This discovery provides additional support to Company A’s lawsuit and provides a basis for possible future compensation. In the end, Company A brought Company B to court, asking it to stop its breach of contract and to compensate for the resulting losses. During the trial, the legal team successfully presented various evidence to the judge, including contract documents, procurement records, and cooperation with other companies. This evidence strongly proves Company B’s breach of contract and the damage caused to Company A. The court finally made a judgment and found that Company B had indeed breached the contract, and ordered it to stop the breach of contract and compensate Company A for 50% of its lost profits, totaling X million yuan. This case has become a classic case in the field of commercial law and attracted widespread attention. Through this case, we can see that in business transactions, it is very important to abide by the contract. Any breach of contract by either party will result in legal liability. Both parties should make a clear agreement and take timely legal action to protect their rights and interests. At the same time, hiring a professional law firm can help parties provide legal support and protection to ensure the realization of legitimate rights and interests.

58_5_1.content: In terms of immunology in the medical field, Shi Haiyan and her mentor Yang Xi jointly conducted a study on the immune tolerance mechanism in breast cancer treatment. They collected breast cancer tissue samples from a group of breast cancer patients and analyzed the tumor cells and immune cells. Shi Haiyan used her expertise in the field of biomedical science to conduct in-depth studies of immune cell types in breast cancer tissues and the immune properties of tumor cells by using immunological experimental techniques such as monoclonal antibodies and flow cytometry. Her supervisor, Yang Xi, gave her important guidance and support in her research, helping her solve difficulties in experiments and providing valuable suggestions. Through collaboration, Shi Haiyan and Yang Xi discovered that there are a large number of immune cells in breast cancer tissues, such as CD4+ T cells, CD8+ T cells and infiltrating macrophages, and found that the expression of PD-L1 protein on the surface of tumor cells increased significantly. In further research, they simulated the breast cancer microenvironment through in vitro culture models and used anti-PD-L1 antibodies to interfere with the binding between PD-L1 and its receptor PD-1. Experimental results show that anti-PD-L1 antibodies can significantly inhibit the growth of tumor cells and enhance the killing activity of immune cells. In order to verify the clinical application prospects of the experimental results, they also conducted a clinical trial of PD-L1 inhibitors on a group of breast cancer patients and monitored the patient's survival and tumor changes. The results show that PD-L1 inhibitors can significantly improve the survival rate of breast cancer patients and reduce tumor size. This study provides a strong basis for the application of immunotherapy in the treatment of breast cancer and is of great significance for further research and clinical practice in this field.

60_3_2.content: With the cooperation of Jiang Yan and Wang Lei, they launched an interesting research project on the reproductive behavior of brown civets. They traveled to a forest and grassland area in southeastern Asia on May 12, 2021, which is the habitat of the brown civet. During this period, Jiang Yan and Wang Lei tracked, observed and recorded the behavior of wild brown civets to understand their communication and reproduction methods. They closely observed the calls of female brown civets and the reactions of males, and recorded their interactions. They found that during the breeding season of brown civets, competition between males is very fierce, and fierce fights often occur, including hair rubbing and minor wounds. Jiang Yan and Wang Lei also observed the nest selection behavior of female brown civets. They recorded how the females chose tree holes, dense forest bottoms, and dense vegetation as safe nests for their cubs. Through their research, they revealed communication patterns, reproductive behavior and survival strategies of the pups during brown civet reproduction. This research is of great significance for understanding the ecological habits of brown civets and protecting the reproduction and survival of this species.

61_2_1.content: On a certain day of a certain month of a certain year, the Beijing Municipal People's Court made a judgment on an infringement dispute case involving advertising law. The plaintiff company is a well-known fashion brand 'Fashion Beauty', and the defendant company is an emerging e-commerce platform 'Shengshi Shopping'. The focus of the dispute in this case was an advertisement published by the defendant company that infringed on the trademark rights and reputation rights of the plaintiff company. During the trial of the case, the court found that the defendant company published an advertisement on its platform to attract consumers to purchase fashion products on its platform. The advertisement used the plaintiff's company's registered trademark 'Fashion Beauty' and its iconic products with high visibility. The defendant company used the trademark and product image of the plaintiff company in advertisements without the permission of the plaintiff company, which misled consumers and made them think that the plaintiff company was directly related to the defendant company. This not only damaged the trademark rights of the plaintiff company, but also seriously infringed on its reputation rights. The court found that the defendant company's behavior infringed on the plaintiff's trademark rights and reputation rights, and violated the provisions of the Advertising Law on advertising publishing. According to the provisions of the Advertising Law, others are not allowed to use others’ registered trademarks in advertisements without the permission of the right holder, and are not allowed to conduct false or misleading advertising. The court ruled in accordance with the law that the defendant company should compensate the plaintiff company for economic losses of 500,000 yuan, and bear corresponding legal responsibilities such as public apology. During the trial of this case, Guo Ming, as a designer, focuses on headwear design, and his girlfriend Li Xue has always given him firm support. As a partner who loves art and travel, Li Xue provided moral support to Guo Ming in court, and together with Guo Ming looked forward to justice being served. The trial and judgment of this case further consolidated my country's legal construction and legal practice in the field of advertising law, and promoted fair competition and the healthy development of the business environment. The court's resolute crackdown on advertising infringements provides companies with a fair and just market competition environment and protects consumers' rights to know and choose. The verdict of this case is of great significance for protecting trademark rights and interests, maintaining market order and consumer interests. It also serves as a strong warning to other infringing advertising publishers.
61_2_1.summary: Li Xue supports Guo Ming in court

66_6_0.content: Pei Li noticed that her neighbor Liu Yang had symptoms of joint pain and swelling, and was diagnosed with atypical rheumatoid arthritis. Pei Li and Liu Yang conducted detailed pathological anatomy analysis to help Liu Yang understand the mechanism and scope of the disease. Through pathological section observation, it was found that Liu Yang's joint synovium had an obvious inflammatory reaction. The synovium was thickened and congested, and a large amount of serous fluid and inflammatory exudate accumulated, causing the joint cavity to expand. The proliferation of subsynovial fibrous tissue caused by the inflammatory reaction further leads to the degeneration of articular cartilage, which is manifested by the reduction of chondrocytes, damage to the cartilage matrix, and the gradual thinning and wear of the articular cartilage. In addition to joint damage, atypical rheumatoid arthritis can also affect other organ systems, such as the lungs and heart. Through immunohistochemistry analysis, Pei Li found that immunoglobulin deposition and T cell infiltration could be seen in the inflammatory lesions, indicating that the immune response plays an important role in the occurrence and development of the disease. Pei Li and Liu Yang jointly studied this case, helping Liu Yang better understand his disease, while also providing valuable data and observations for research in the medical community.

67_3_1.content: Chu Jie and Zhang Wei occasionally walked together after dinner and exchanged trivial matters in life. On this day, they talked about China's monetary policy. Chu Jie explained to Zhang Wei China's 'walking on two legs' strategy, an economic policy first proposed by China in the 1980s. He told Zhang Wei that the purpose of this strategy is to balance the relationship between macro-control and market autonomy and promote economic development and stability. Chu Jie introduced in detail the measures taken by the central bank to implement this strategy, including targeted reserve requirement ratio cuts and reverse repurchase operations. He explained that the central bank guides the flow of funds to key areas and weak areas in the real economy by making differentiated adjustments to the deposit reserve ratios of different types of financial institutions. This can balance liquidity and avoid economic fluctuations caused by excessive looseness or tightness of monetary policy. In addition, Chu Jie also mentioned that the central bank uses reverse repurchase operations, that is, selling government bonds to withdraw liquidity, to affect the supply and demand relationship of market interest rates. Chu Jie also pointed out that when implementing monetary policy, the central bank will comprehensively consider the global economic environment, price levels, asset bubbles and other factors to maintain the comprehensiveness and flexibility of the policy. He emphasized that the coordination of monetary policy and fiscal policy can achieve better macro-control effects. Zhang Wei listened with great interest.
