67_3_2.content: Chu Jie and Zhang Wei occasionally walk together on weekends and exchange trivial matters in life. During one of their walks, they talked about the book 'The Cloisters of Narracorn' by the famous scholar Roland Barthes. Chu Jie introduced the background and research results of this book to Zhang Wei in detail. He told Zhang Wei that this book was published in 1968 and is widely regarded as one of Barthes' masterpieces. 'The Cloisters of Naracona' mainly explores the communication nature of literature and the relationship between literature and other social and cultural fields. Through detailed analysis of literary works, Barthes tried to reveal the interactive relationship between authors and readers, as well as the meaning of works in specific social and cultural contexts. He also mentions important named entities such as Gideon Spenser and Flaubert, as well as Madame Bovary. Chu Jie told Zhang Wei that Bart focused on the examination of the author's personal experience, social background and creative motivations, and through these details, revealed the deep meaning and critical value of the work. In addition, 'The Cloisters of Narracón' also explores some important critical theories, such as Barthes's theoretical construction of the classification of narrator roles in novels and the relationship between characters, as well as criticism of the structure of modern novels. Chu Jie said that this book provides an in-depth discussion of literary criticism theory through the study of literary works. Through specific named entities, detailed analysis and theoretical construction, Barthes attempts to reveal the meaning and social background behind the work, as well as the interactive relationship between readers and the work. Chu Jie believes that this book provides useful inspiration for deepening our understanding of literary criticism. Zhang Wei was very interested in the information shared by Chu Jie. He said he would find time to read this book and looked forward to further communicating his understanding and feelings with Chu Jie.
67_3_2.summary: Discuss the research results of 'The Cloisters of Narakon'

After spending a pleasant time in the library, Shi Jie and Wang Li decided to apply what they had learned to practical problems. They discussed superconducting materials used in maglev trains, such as thulium yttrium gadolinium lanthanum barium copper oxide (YBa2Cu3O7-x), which becomes superconducting at low temperatures and has zero resistance and complete diamagnetism. Gong Chao and Yang Jing discussed the advantages of maglev trains, such as high speed and low energy consumption, and learned that superconductivity also has important application value in fields such as medical imaging and energy transmission. After listening to Mr. Chen's introduction, Gong Chao had a deeper understanding of Huawei's impact on international trade. They first went to Ruan Wenting's family's Red Mansion. As the family's residence, the Red Mansion left a deep impression on Zhang Lin. Zhang Lin was attracted by the large and complex complex of Red Mansions and admired its exquisite decoration and meticulous carvings. They came to the conservation center in Ya'an City on May 10, 2019, and visited a protected area of more than 30,000 hectares. Ruan Wenting introduced the background and goals of giant panda protection to Zhang Lin, and shared her research results on public health and environmental protection. During the visit, they witnessed the advanced giant panda nursery and observed the professional care and protection work of the keepers. Both Ruan Wenting and Zhang Lin were deeply moved, and they had a deeper understanding of the rarity of giant pandas and the importance of conservation efforts. After the visit, Ruan Wenting and Zhang Lin decided to actively participate in the publicity and education of giant panda protection, hoping to contribute to the protection of this endangered species through their own efforts.

They heard about the reputation of the restaurant King of Prairie Roasted Whole Lamb and decided to go there to taste the authentic roasted whole lamb. They agreed to go to the grassland to roast the whole sheep king together on June 15, 2022. After arriving at the restaurant, Ruan Wenting and Zhang Lin were personally greeted by Master Wang. Master Wang introduced them to the process of making roasted whole lamb and showed them the unique skills of roasting lamb. Ruan Wenting and Zhang Lin watched with interest as Master Wang marinated the selected whole lamb with clean internal organs and placed the lamb on the large charcoal grill. When an authentic roasted whole lamb was served, Ruan Wenting and Zhang Lin were attracted by its aroma. They tasted the tender and juicy meat, and the juices of the fresh meat overflowed from their mouths. Ruan Wenting exclaimed: 'This is the most delicious roasted whole lamb I have ever tasted!' Zhang Lin excitedly shared her feelings: 'It's really great! The texture and taste of this roasted whole lamb are unforgettable!' They said It is also paired with local specialties of hand-picked rice and grassland milk tea, adding a sense of gourmet satisfaction. While dining, Ruan Wenting and Zhang Lin enjoyed the Mongolian folk dance performance and the grassland equestrian performance, and felt the unique charm of the grassland national culture. They shared joy and laughter with Master Wang and other tourists and spent an unforgettable night of cultural exchange.

83_1_0.content: While Yu Jiajia was engaged in agricultural product processing, her close friend Wang Mingyang was also conducting in-depth research in the field of metal chemistry. Due to their years of friendship and mutual trust, they often exchange their research results and look for possible collaboration opportunities. Then add dark soy sauce, light soy sauce, cooking wine, and rock sugar and stir-fry evenly to color every piece of meat. Then add an appropriate amount of water, just enough to cover the pork pieces, cover the pot and simmer. During the simmering process, the two of them take turns turning the pieces of meat to ensure even cooking. After simmering for about 30 minutes, the aroma of the braised pork overflows and the meat becomes tender and delicious. Yu Jiajia and Li Ting tasted a piece of braised pork and were both amazed. 84_1_2.content: In 2019, Wei Jianhua participated in an exciting outdoor adventure with his college friend Zhang Wei. They gathered in a wild camp far away from the city and enjoyed the beauty of nature. During the expedition, Wei Jianhua shared with Zhang Wei his research results as an environmental ethicist and his passion for environmental protection. Together they discussed the work of the EHT project, which has recently attracted global attention in taking photos of black holes. Wei Jianhua introduced Zhang Wei in detail the background and operating principles of the EHT project, including a huge radio telescope array composed of 8 telescopes around the world. They discussed the mysteries of black holes and how the EHT project, through long-term observations and radio interferometry techniques, captured the first image of the supermassive black hole M87* at the center of the Milky Way M87 galaxy. Wei Jianhua excitedly shared the significance of this achievement to the fields of black hole physics, universe and quantum physics. Zhang Wei expressed his admiration for this breakthrough research result, and discussed with Wei Jianhua the gravitational field of black holes and the phenomenon of light being affected by the gravity of black holes. They are full of curiosity to explore the mysteries of the universe revealed by black hole photos, and look forward to similar observation programs in the future bringing more images and data of black holes. This outdoor adventure deepened the friendship between Wei Jianhua and Zhang Wei and created beautiful memories for them to share every detail of their lives.

84_2_0.content: Wei Jianhua and Li Yating planned an unforgettable romantic trip to explore the rainforest ecosystem of Madagascar. They set out on July 15, 2021, and came to the rainforest areas in the east and north of Madagascar. The area's unique species and rich ecosystem attracted their attention. They explored along the winding trails in the dense forest and experienced the beauty and mystery of nature immersively. During this expedition, they witnessed the majestic sight of the Madagascar Bigfoot Monkey (Indri), the largest tailless ape in the world, which left a deep impression on them. They also noticed unique bat species such as the Madagascar long-nosed bat and Kadawi's bat, which amazed them with body structures that differed from bats in other areas. In addition, they also admired the giant 'Bayowa flower', a giant peach plant in the Madagascar rainforest, which towers into the clouds, is beautiful and spectacular. Wei Jianhua and Li Yating were immersed in this unique ecosystem and were attracted by its rich biodiversity and complex ecological chain. However, they also see huge threats to the rainforest, with human activities such as illegal logging and overgrazing destroying this valuable natural asset. During the expedition, they became deeply aware of the importance of protecting the Madagascar rainforest ecosystem and decided to spread this issue to more people. After the expedition, they returned to China and jointly held an environmental lecture, calling on the public to protect the natural environment, especially precious ecosystems. Their efforts are recognized and their romantic journey becomes one of the important chapters in their pursuit of life ideals.

86_0_0.content: Last summer, Yuan Juan and her sister Yuan Li took an unforgettable family trip together. The location of this trip is their ancestral home - Zhangjiajie City, Hunan Province, China. As two sisters, Yuan Juan and Yuan Li share similar interests, including reading history books and traveling. They have traveled together to explore historical sites around the world and share their insights and perspectives. During this family trip, Yuan Juan and Yuan Li went on several hikes in the Wulingyuan Scenic Area in Zhangjiajie City, Hunan Province, enjoying the spectacular landscapes of this beautiful area. During this trip, they also tried the exciting experience of the high-altitude glass plank road and tasted local traditional food during the tour. This trip not only deepened the relationship between sisters Yuan Juan and Yuan Li, but also allowed them to better understand the history and culture of their ancestral home. After returning home, Yuan Juan and Yuan Li often recalled this wonderful trip together and shared photos and travel diaries with each other. They firmly believe that family travel is a treasured experience that can bring them unforgettable memories and further strengthen their bond.

86_1_0.content: On May 12, 2018, Yuan Juan and her college classmate Li Ming met in a cafe in Beijing to share their interest in historical research. Li Ming is a teacher and also has a strong interest in history. As soon as the two sat down, they began to talk about their research results and experiences. Yuan Juan first introduced a historical monograph she recently completed, which studies the development and influence of ancient Chinese culture. She shared her insights on cultural heritage protection and her thoughts on the importance of historical education. After hearing this, Li Ming expressed great agreement and mentioned that he has recently been exploring some specific areas of ancient Chinese culture, such as music and drama. He introduced in detail his research progress and findings in these fields, and also discussed with Yuan Juan the inheritance and development of ancient Chinese culture in modern society. The whole process was full of academic atmosphere, and the two inspired more inspirations and ideas from each other. They also recommended some of the latest historical books to each other and discussed the ideas and arguments in them. This exchange made Yuan Juan and Li Ming better understand each other's research directions and enhanced their friendship. They decided to keep in touch in the future, explore more areas of historical research together, and support and encourage each other.

86_1_1.content: Xiaojuan and her college classmate Li Ming paid attention to the 2015 Pluto exploration mission. The mission revealed many mysterious landforms on Pluto, such as a large number of glaciers and mountains, as well as a coastline that looks like a giant heart on the surface. The New Horizons probe's discoveries have given them insights into Pluto's surface features and increased interest in the formation and evolution of the solar system. Xiaojuan and Li Ming often discuss the latest progress of the Pluto mission, share each other's discoveries and ideas, and stimulate each other's curiosity about the universe. They all believe that this mission has contributed important data to mankind's exploration of the boundaries of the solar system and understanding of the grand pattern of the universe.

86_2_0.content: On a sunny summer afternoon, Xiaojuan and her boyfriend Zhang Yu were sitting in the study room at home, immersed in the world of mathematics and game theory. They were discussing the famous prisoner's dilemma case in game theory, and in order to better understand the case, they launched a romantic duel of minds. Xiaojuan competed with Yuan Juan's profound knowledge as a historian and Zhang Yu's outstanding logical thinking. They challenge each other, analyze various strategies and outcomes, and explore rational choices and dilemmas in the game. Xiaojuan immersed herself in her own historical knowledge and used game scenarios between various groups and individuals in history to add more dimensions to the case. Zhang Yu relied on his mathematical skills to deeply analyze the game matrix and utility function, and deduce the results of different decisions. Together they search for Nash equilibrium points and consider how rational decision-making affects individual and collective interests in the Prisoner's Dilemma. Their discussions not only covered the fields of economics, political science and sociology, but also extended to many fields such as game strategies in historical events and human behavioral psychology. This in-depth discussion not only enhanced each other's cognition and thinking ability, but also shortened the emotional distance between them. Xiaojuan and Zhang Yu encouraged and appreciated each other's thinking and analysis, and shared each other's views and thoughts on cooperation and betrayal. This plot not only adds a touch of romance to historian Yuan Juan's independent research, but also makes her relationship with her boyfriend stronger, as they understand and appreciate each other's wisdom and unique insights.

They found a comfortable cinema, sat down in the screening room, and prepared to start this anticipated movie journey. When the movie started, Xiaojuan couldn't help but admire the painting style and background in the movie. She noticed that the detailed and gorgeous pictures in the movie gave her an immersive movie-watching experience. Zhang Yu particularly likes the soundtrack composed by Joe Hisaishi for the movie. Each piece of music perfectly echoes the development of the plot and adds touching emotions to the movie. Together, Xiaojuan and Zhang Yu witnessed the adventure and growth that Qianxun experienced in the lost mysterious world. They were fascinated by the film's themes of growth, courage and self-discovery, which sparked their reflections on life and history. After watching the movie, Xiaojuan and Zhang Yu had a lively discussion about the work 'Spirited Away'. They exchanged views on topics such as their understanding of the characters in the film, the meaning behind the story, and the impact of animated films on cultural communication. This movie night not only enhanced the relationship between Xiaojuan and Zhang Yu, but also made them appreciate and respect each other's academic insights and enthusiasm. Xiaojuan and Zhang Yu decided to continue exploring history and culture together in the future, and planned more movie nights to bring more common topics and beautiful memories to each other.

86_2_2.content: Together with her boyfriend Zhang Yu, Xiaojuan was attracted by the residents of Xinliu Town and became curious about the mysterious power of Xinliu Place. They decided to cooperate to investigate and understand the reality and potential risks of this phenomenon. During the investigation, they visited flow places and had in-depth discussions with residents. They interviewed some residents and learned that some people experienced uncontrollable behavioral changes after experiencing flow places. Xiaojuan and Zhang Yu gradually uncovered some secrets behind the flow place. Through conversations and analysis with residents, they discovered that flow places may be closely related to people’s subconscious and psychological emotions. She also shared the progress scientists are making in exploring how to apply Graphene to existing electronic devices and develop new nanotechnology. 87_0_2.content: As Xiaohua's wife, He Wei is very concerned about autism. The protagonist of one specific case is an autistic boy named Xiaohua. He Wei was attracted by the plot in the picture book. In the illustrations, she saw Xiaohua facing various challenges in a special school, including emotional control, social disorders and special interests. He Wei also noticed Xiaohua's difficulties in social interaction. He had difficulty understanding other people's feelings and intentions and avoided eye contact. In class gatherings, Xiaohua would just sit in the corner alone, with no intention of communicating with others. In addition, He Wei also saw Xiaohua's passion for music and sensitivity to gentle touch stimulation. She recognized the need for individuals with autism to have individualized support and a structured environment, as well as the importance of social skills training. He Wei is very interested in this picture book and the advice provided by psychologists. She hopes to better support the growth of autistic patients and create a better quality of life for them.

91_6_0.content: As Wei Gang's neighbor, Yang Yun recently went to a local hospital to undergo a magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) examination because of physical discomfort. MRI technology is widely used in the medical field and can provide precise images of body structures and tissues. According to the doctor's instructions, Yang Yun went to the hospital on June 10 and underwent an MRI examination. During this process, Yang Yun was guided into a device equipped with a 2T strong magnet and lay flat in the inspection area. Doctors activated the magnets in the device, creating a powerful static magnetic field. Doctors then sent radio pulses into Yang Yun's body to perturb the static magnetic field and stimulate water molecules in the tissue. The water molecules in Yang Yun's body will generate a specific response signal, which will be received by a set of radio frequency coils. The received signals were combined and reconstructed to produce a highly detailed image of the structure and tissue of Yang Yun's body. By observing and analyzing these images, doctors can compare the examination with known normal physiological patterns to diagnose disease and plan treatment. Yang Yun's MRI examination results will provide doctors with important diagnostic information, helping to judge Yang Yun's physical condition and make corresponding treatment decisions.

They are full of expectations for the various charms of the Nile River. On the day of the trip, Qin Yu and Li Hua arrived in Egypt by plane, then transferred to a cruise ship to gradually explore along the Nile River. They stopped in the middle of the Nile River in Lake Victoria and enjoyed the natural beauty of the lake, mountains and coast. They then traveled to the Sudanese plains and visited the swampy terrain of the Nile River, witnessing this important biodiversity and bird habitat. During the trip, Qin Yu and Li Hua also tasted local specialties, exchanged culture with local people, and felt the enthusiasm and vitality of Africa. This trip not only gave them a deeper understanding of the geographical characteristics of the Nile River, the development of human civilization and the local socio-economic conditions, but also enhanced the friendship and mutual understanding between brothers. 97_1_0.content: In the conference room of the mental health ward of the hospital, Zou Min, a good friend of a cultural policy expert, participated in a meeting about the Zentangle case in art therapy. At the meeting, a professional art therapist introduced the concept of Zentangle to several patients suffering from anxiety disorders. The therapist displays some basic patterns on a large whiteboard and guides the patients to practice together. Zou Min and Wang Juan sit next to their patients and encourage them to relax, drawing specific repetitive patterns and textures to relieve anxiety, improve focus and promote relaxation. Patients gradually select basic patterns that interest them and draw them using a special pen. Zou Min and Wang Juan work with therapists to observe each patient's emotions and performance, and provide timely positive feedback and encouragement. Patients gradually gain a sense of control and accomplishment over their paintings, and they begin to experiment with various combinations of colors and textures to add more layers and uniqueness to their paintings. Therapists also encourage them to fill their paintings with imagery or images from memory to stimulate inner creativity and expression. Under the guidance of the therapist, Zou Min and Wang Juan shared the meaning and emotions behind the works with the patients, expressing and deepening their understanding of their inner world through language. 101_5_1.content: On March 15, 2022, Bao Jun’s girlfriend Li Xiao, as a human rights lawyer, is concerned about social justice and legal reform. She and Bao Jun jointly focus on emergency medicine in the medical field. One day, they heard about a classic medical case involving a patient named Zhang Ming. Zhang Ming is a 30-year-old male with a strong build and has always been in good health in the past. Suddenly one day, he developed severe abdominal pain and vomiting, and felt his blood pressure drop. In an emergency, he was taken to the emergency room for treatment. Doctors performed a quick examination and found significant tenderness in his abdomen, along with bloating and paroxysmal twitching. Doctors immediately performed electrocardiogram monitoring and collected blood samples for laboratory testing. Laboratory results showed that Zhang Ming's white blood cell count increased and his C-reactive protein level also increased significantly, suggesting the presence of infectious diseases. Based on the clinical manifestations and laboratory results, doctors suspected that Zhang Ming might have suffered from acute appendicitis. In order to further confirm the diagnosis, the doctor conducted an abdominal CT scan for Zhang Ming. The scan results showed that Zhang Ming's appendix was partially thickened, an abscess formed around it, and the appendix lumen was significantly expanded. In an emergency, the doctor decided to perform surgery on Zhang Ming to prevent the appendix from rupturing. During the operation, doctors found that the appendix was severely inflamed and partially necrotic, indicating that Zhang Ming's condition was more serious than expected. Doctors immediately performed an appendectomy and performed an appendix biopsy to further confirm the diagnosis. The biopsy results showed that there was bacterial infection in Zhang Ming's appendix, confirming the diagnosis of acute appendicitis. After the operation, the doctor gave Zhang Ming appropriate antibiotic treatment and postoperative care. Zhang Ming's abdominal pain and vomiting symptoms gradually eased after treatment, and his body temperature gradually returned to normal. This case vividly demonstrates the diagnosis and treatment process of emergency medicine in the medical field, and at the same time reminds people to pay attention to acute abdomen and the importance of timely medical treatment.

101_7_1.content: At a legal seminar on March 15, 2022, Bao Jun worked with his colleague Li Ming to organize a lecture on quantum computers. He explained that quantum computers use the principles of quantum mechanics to perform efficient calculations in a parallel computing manner, and showed Google's Sycamore quantum processor as an important example. He emphasized that the Sycamore quantum processor consists of 54 superconducting qubits, each of which can be in multiple states at the same time and entangled through quantum gate operations. He also mentioned that the core operations of the Sycamore quantum processor include Hadamard gates, CNOT gates, etc. These operations can operate qubits and realize the control and measurement of qubits. Bao Jun pointed out that in order to maintain the stability of quantum computers, Sycamore quantum processors need to operate at extremely low temperatures, and explained the potential of quantum computers and the 'quantum advantage' achieved in some cases. This lecture not only gave participants a deeper understanding of quantum computers, but also triggered lively discussions and exchanges among the participants.

102_1_0.content: On March 15, 2010, Wenjie, as a well-known domestic cultural heritage management expert, shared the case of NGC 2440 with the participants at an astronomy research report held by a cultural heritage protection institution. In the report, Wenjie introduced in detail the characteristics and details of NGC 2440 as a striking celestial body case. He vividly described the formation and evolution of the white dwarf star in NGC 2440 and the surrounding planetary material, as well as their impact on the cosmic environment. After the report, Xiaofang, as Wenjie's childhood friend, expressed her appreciation and interest in the content of his speech to Wenjie, and discussed some issues about astronomy research with Wenjie. The two discussed the details of NGC 2440 with great interest, including the characteristics of white dwarfs, the morphological differences of planetary materials, and the significance of dust lanes and frozen gas clouds. Their discussions not only enriched each other's knowledge, but also deepened their friendship.

102_1_1.content: On May 10, 2023, Wenjie and his childhood sweetheart Xiaofang made an appointment to meet. Xiaofang has recently launched an entrepreneurial project called 'Smart City Environmental Monitoring', which is closely related to the smart city management platform. Xiaofang's project aims to use the Internet of Things and big data technology to provide comprehensive urban environment monitoring and analysis services to help cities achieve more intelligent and sustainable development. Xiaofang introduced her project concept and technical implementation plan to Wenjie. She plans to cooperate with modules such as the Urban Intelligence Center and the Big Data Analysis Center to jointly promote the construction of smart cities. Wenjie was very supportive of Xiaofang’s entrepreneurial project and provided some suggestions and help, including contacting his colleagues who previously worked in a cultural heritage protection agency to understand how to obtain relevant city data, and sharing his own experience in cultural heritage management. Experience and insights. Wenjie believes that through Xiaofang’s efforts and the promotion of the smart city management platform, the city’s management efficiency and residents’ quality of life will be further improved.
102_1_1.summary: Xiaofang’s urban environment monitoring entrepreneurial project

102_1_2.content: During the Spring Festival, Wenjie and Xiaofang visited relatives and friends together. Wearing traditional Hanfu, they visit their elders and friends along the street to wish them a Happy New Year. They knock on doors and enter every house, politely greet the New Year and give red envelopes. They say blessing words, such as 'Congratulations on getting rich,' 'Good health,' and 'All the best.' During the visit, they were invited into the living room to participate in the preparations for the New Year's Eve dinner. They enjoy a sumptuous New Year's Eve dinner with their families, including fish, meat, vegetables and various traditional snacks. Each dish has a unique name, which means good luck and harvest. For example, 'Carp Jumping over the Dragon Gate' represents good luck, and 'Longevity Noodles' represent longevity. They sat around with Xiaofang’s family, chatting while eating, and shared each other’s New Year’s plans and expectations. This moment was filled with the warmth of family and friendship, making them feel the importance of family and friendship.

102_2_0.content: Wenjie and his lover Mei Mei planned a romantic trip and chose to go to the Luofu Mountain Grottoes in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, Jiangsu Province, China. They walked together among the grottoes and felt the atmosphere of long history and art. Mei Mei was deeply attracted by the unique sculpture style and rich and diverse statues of the Luofu Mountain Grottoes. She told Wenjie about her love for cultural heritage and her unique feeling for art. Wenjie gently held the beautiful hand and accompanied her to carefully appreciate the Buddha statues, reliefs and murals preserved in each grotto. In front of the ninth cave, Wenjie pointed to the 33-meter-high Reclining Buddha and introduced this exquisite work of art to Meili, telling its history and uniqueness. Beautiful and amazed, she recorded this beautiful moment with her camera, closely connecting this magnificent reclining Buddha with Wenjie. Later, they went inside the grotto to admire many murals, and were impressed by the rich colors and superb techniques. They shared their understanding of the historical scenes and characters depicted in the murals in the grotto, and exchanged their thoughts and feelings. At the end of the trip to the Luofu Mountain Grottoes, Wenjie walked out of the grottoes with beauty, and continued walking hand in hand in the natural scenery of Luofu Mountain, reminiscing about this romantic cultural journey.

102_2_1.content: Wenjie and Meimei planned a romantic birthday celebration. They chose an ancient and peaceful cultural heritage reserve as their date location, with an ancient temple and magnificent ancient buildings. It was a sunny day, and the breeze blew across their cheeks, giving them a peaceful and comfortable feeling. Wenjie has prepared a book about the history and culture of the heritage reserve in advance, hoping to read it with Mei and share his love for cultural heritage. As they walked, they talked about the structure and cultural background of ancient buildings, and explored this cultural treasure together. As time passed, they came to a courtyard with a huge old tree and a carefully arranged dining table under the tree. The table was filled with delicious food and exquisite cakes. Wenjie personally prepared delicious dishes and desserts, bringing a wonderful surprise to Beauty. Under the gentle sunshine, they shared their lives and dreams with each other while tasting delicious food. Wenjie showed his photography works to Meili, including many photos of cultural heritage, recording his testimony of participation in conservation projects over the years. Meili was moved to say that she was proud of Wenjie's talent and dedication, and expressed her willingness to always support his career. Finally, Wenjie gave Meili a carefully selected gift, a precious cultural heritage album, which collected photos and detailed introductions of cultural heritage from all over the world. Mei Mei happily accepted the gift and said it was one of the most meaningful gifts she had ever received. They spent a romantic and unforgettable moment together on this special day, feeling happy and contented with their love for each other and their shared passion.

102_3_0.content: Wenjie and Zhang Wei were classmates in college. They once visited an interior design studio called 'Art Space' together. The studio is located in a modern building in the center of Beijing, covering an area of about 500 square meters. After entering the studio, the first thing they saw was a curved sculpture corridor lined with a series of artworks, including home lamps designed by Li Xiaohua and sculptures by the famous sculptor Zhang Wei. Zhang Wei's sculptures demonstrate his unique insights into nature and human life and are fascinating. In the main work area, they saw a spacious and bright design showroom filled with furniture samples of various materials and styles. The walls around the showroom are covered with photos and real-life images of various well-known projects that Li Xiaohua and the studio design team have participated in, including a well-known hotel in Beijing CBD and a well-known office building in Shanghai Hongqiao Business Center. These projects showcase the talent and creativity of designers. At the rear of the studio, they entered a lounge that featured a modern art installation and walls covered with abstract paintings created by internationally renowned artists. Designers can relax here and enjoy various art videos and design lectures. Smart home systems are also used throughout the interior design, adding a modern and futuristic feel to the studio. After the visit, Wenjie and Zhang Wei expressed their appreciation for the studio's design concepts and creativity, and had an in-depth discussion on the way back.

102_3_1.content: In 2016, Wenjie, as a good friend of his college classmate Zhang Wei, was invited to participate in the launch event of the Adidas and Alexander Wang collaboration series. This event was held in an international fashion city and attracted the attention of many fashion enthusiasts and media. Zhang Wei, as the senior marketing manager of Adidas, is one of the main organizers of this event. He was responsible for coordinating all details at the event site to ensure the smooth progress of the entire event. Wenjie met with Zhang Wei before the event. The two recalled the good times in college and discussed the design and promotion strategy of the cooperation series. After the event officially started, Wenjie and Zhang Wei visited the display area and admired the display of AW Run Clean sneakers and other accessories. They shared with each other what they loved about design, as well as the impact and significance of the collaborative series in the fashion field. The whole event was full of passion and creativity, which gave Wenjie a deeper understanding and experience of the combination of fashion and sports.
102_3_1.Theme: Adidas and Alexander Wang collaboration series

102_3_2.content: In college, Wenjie studied engineering and construction courses with his classmate Zhang Wei. Among them, they studied the structural design of the Shanghai Tower together. They conducted an in-depth analysis of the main structure of the building, including five main structural elements: central core, auxiliary core, spiral staircase, open space and peripheral frame. They discuss the importance of the precise design and earthquake resistance of these structures to ensure the safety of the entire building. At the same time, they also studied the advanced materials used in the Shanghai Tower, such as high-performance concrete and high-performance glass. They conducted an in-depth exploration of the role of these materials in improving the stability and durability of building structures. In addition, they learned about the unique design used in the Shanghai Tower, a dual-base shock absorber system. They learned that this design can effectively reduce structural vibrations caused by earthquakes, thereby improving the stability of the building and the safety of residents. During this joint learning process, Wenjie and Zhang Wei communicated and inspired each other, and jointly improved their understanding and knowledge of the field of engineering construction.
102_3_2.summary: Learn the structural design of Shanghai Tower

102_4_0.content: On March 15, 2022, Li Na found Wenjie at the office of the cultural heritage protection agency and consulted him about Chinese medicine treatment for chronic fatigue syndrome. Li Na mentioned that she has a friend who suffers from CFS and has been unable to find an effective treatment. She hopes to learn about the effectiveness of traditional Chinese medicine in treating this disease. After Wenjie heard Li Na's question, he immediately launched a detailed explanation and discussion. He introduced to Li Na the advantages of traditional Chinese medicine in treating CFS and mentioned the importance of the classic medical book 'Nei Jing' to traditional Chinese medicine. Wenjie explained that the 'Nei Jing' contains a wealth of traditional Chinese medicine prescriptions and acupuncture treatments, which are widely used in the treatment of CFS. He explained several aspects of the traditional Chinese medicine treatment plan to Li Na in detail, including syndrome differentiation and treatment, acupuncture therapy, health care and psychological adjustment. He mentioned that for the specific conditions of CFS patients, traditional Chinese medicine will consider the overall situation, identify the specific manifestations of the disease, and select corresponding traditional Chinese medicine treatment plans and acupuncture treatments according to different syndromes. In addition, traditional Chinese medicine also emphasizes health care measures such as diet, regular work and rest, and appropriate exercise, as well as the importance of a good mentality and positive and optimistic emotions to patients. Wenjie provided Li Na with some recommended TCM treatment options and suggested that she pass this information on to her friends so that they could consult professional TCM physicians for further diagnosis and treatment. Li Na expressed her gratitude to Wenjie for his answers and decided to convey this information to her friend, hoping to provide him with some help and guidance.
102_4_0.summary: Li Na consults Wenjie about Chinese medicine treatment for CFS
102_4_0.Theme: A case study of traditional Chinese medicine treating chronic fatigue syndrome

102_4_1.content: Wenjie and Li Na collaborated on a domestic cultural heritage protection project. This project is to restore and protect an ancient building to retain its historical and cultural value. The project involves the research of architectural structures, protection of cultural relics, and management of cultural heritage. As an expert in cultural heritage management, Wenjie is responsible for the overall planning and management of the project and works closely with Li Na. Li Na is a senior cultural relics protection expert, responsible for on-site inspections, formulation of cultural relics protection plans and implementation supervision. The two of them work closely together to solve various problems and challenges in the project through consultation and discussion. During the project, Wenjie and Li Na not only jointly formulated a detailed work plan and timetable, but also collaborated with the work team on the division of labor and coordination of various tasks. They communicate and evaluate project progress through weekly meetings and on-site inspections to ensure that the project is completed on time and the quality of the restoration and protection work is guaranteed. In the final stage of the project, Wenjie and Li Na also jointly organized an exhibition of the restored ancient buildings to demonstrate the results and value of the project to the public. Their cooperation has been recognized and praised by professional institutions and relevant experts, and has made positive contributions to the cause of cultural heritage protection.

102_4_2.content: Before the movie was released, Wenjie and Li Na were full of expectations for this much-anticipated film. As colleagues in cultural heritage protection agencies, they are all very interested in virtual reality technology and network culture. So, when the movie was released, they decided to go to the cinema to watch it together. Li Na is a person who is passionate about science fiction and games. She is very interested in the plot and virtual world setting of 'Ready Player One'. In the cinema, they found a good seat and sat down to enjoy this science fiction adventure movie directed by Steven Spielberg. They were attracted by the film's delicate special effects and thrilling plot, and also noticed the emergence of many cultural elements, such as The Iron Giant, Blade Runner, and Star Wars. After watching the movie, they discussed various plots and cultural elements in the movie with great interest, sharing their opinions and feelings with each other. This movie viewing not only enhanced the friendship between Wenjie and Li Na, but also brought more inspiration and inspiration to their work.
102_4_2.summary: Watch the 'Ready Player One' movie with Wenjie

102_5_0.content: At an academic conference, Mr. Zhang shared his cardiovascular health improvement using CardioCare with his mentor, Professor Wang. He mentioned that CardioCare reminds him to take medication on time and check health indicators every day, making his life more regular; and the health reports generated every week help him better understand his health status and take appropriate measures to improve cardiovascular health. . Mr. Zhang also expressed the benefits of using CardioCare with his doctors and family members, who are able to monitor his health status in real time and provide necessary support and advice. After listening to Mr. Zhang’s sharing, Professor Wang expressed his appreciation for the effectiveness of CardioCare and encouraged Mr. Zhang to continue researching and promoting this innovative solution to contribute to improving cardiovascular health for more people.

102_5_0.Theme: CardioCare improves Mr. Zhang’s cardiovascular health

102_5_1.content: During the 2016 US presidential election, Wenjie was a student of Professor Wang and was guided by him, focusing on studying the interactive relationship between social media and politics. Professor Wang is a senior cultural heritage management expert with an international reputation for his rich experience and in-depth knowledge in the field of cultural heritage protection. As Wenjie’s mentor, Professor Wang guided and supported his research project. They discussed the significance of the Facebook data breach and realized what it revealed about the complex relationship between social media and politics. Professor Wang encouraged Wenjie to study this case in depth and analyze its significance to the operation and influence of social media from the perspective of cultural heritage management. During the research process, Wenjie explored the impact of the use of personal data by social media platforms and political candidates on privacy protection and data use through the analysis of multiple named entities such as Cambridge Analytica, the US presidential election, and user personal privacy. Professor Wang's guidance has enabled Wenjie's research to develop more deeply, providing important insights into the interaction between social media and the political field.
102_5_1.summary: Professor Wang guided Wenjie in his research

102_5_2.content: At a cultural heritage management seminar in 2010, young Wenjie was fortunate enough to meet Professor Wang, a senior cultural heritage management expert. Professor Wang is Wenjie’s mentor and one of the keynote speakers at the seminar. Professor Wang is a well-known cultural heritage management expert in China, and his research results and rich experience in conservation projects are widely known. At that time, Wenjie had just started working in cultural heritage management and was full of enthusiasm and eager to learn in this field. During the seminar, Wenjie showed his research results and papers to Professor Wang and hoped to receive Professor Wang's guidance and advice. Professor Wang spoke highly of Wenjie's research performance and expressed his willingness to become his mentor and provide him with guidance and support. Since then, Wenjie and Professor Wang established a teacher-student relationship and began long-term cooperation and exchanges.
102_5_2.summary: Wenjie’s first meeting with Professor Wang

102_6_0.content: In the 2016 NBA Finals, Wenjie’s neighbor Aunt Liu watched the Cleveland Cavaliers against the Golden State Warriors with him. There were two minutes left and the Cavaliers led 103-98. Aunt Liu and Wenjie cheered for the Cavaliers together, hoping that they could maintain the lead. When LeBron James faced Stephen Curry's offense, Aunt Liu stared at the screen nervously, hoping that James could successfully score. When Kevin Love received a pass from James, Aunt Liu clapped and cheered excitedly. However, she was also nervous to see Draymond Green quickly run towards Love to block the shot. Aunt Liu silently cheered for Love, hoping he could withstand the pressure and score. When JR Smith received Love's pass, Aunt Liu jumped up nervously and cheered him on. She saw Smith smoothly advance the ball to the three-point line against Klay Thompson's defense. Aunt Liu hopes that Smith can find opportunities to score and expand the Cavaliers' lead. When Lance Stevenson received Smith's pass, Aunt Liu watched nervously as he turned around in the top arc and prepared to shoot. She saw Andrew Bogut quickly back to block, but Stevenson smartly threw the ball to an open Tristan Thompson in the penalty area. Aunt Liu clapped excitedly and praised the Cavaliers' coordinated attack. When Jordan Clarkson received a pass from Thompson and turned around to shoot in the penalty area, Aunt Liu held her breath, expecting him to perform stably. Finally, when Clarkson hit a three-pointer at the buzzer, Aunt Liu jumped up happily and cheered for the Cavaliers with Wenjie. The cheers from the audience filled Aunt Liu with excitement and joy. She was proud and happy for the Cavaliers' victory.

102_6_1.content: In 2018, Aunt Liu, as Wenjie's neighbor, also continued to pay attention to the development of Sino-US trade friction. Every morning, when Wenjie leaves for work, Aunt Liu always greets him at the door and asks about the latest trade war developments. Together they will discuss the impact of the trade war on the global economy, as well as the positions and progress of negotiations between China and the United States. Aunt Liu often mentioned Huawei as a key company in trade frictions in their conversations. She was concerned about the difficulties Huawei faced in the US market and its position in the global supply chain. Wenjie will share his professional views and analysis on trade frictions, as well as his insights on the role of cultural heritage management in trade frictions. Aunt Liu also admired Wenjie's professional background and encouraged him to publish more papers in the field of cultural heritage protection and make greater contributions to cultural heritage protection. Their friendship has also deepened due to their common concerns about trade frictions, and they have become important supporters and listeners in each other's lives.
102_6_1.summary: Pay attention to the development of trade frictions

102_6_2.content: On March 15, 2022, neighbor Aunt Liu came to Wenjie and asked him about the treatment of hernia. Aunt Liu has been a neighbor of Wenjie for many years. Subsequently, Wenjie used the AI-assisted fundus disease diagnosis system to analyze and diagnose Mr. Zhang’s fundus images. Through deep learning technology and image processing algorithms, the system quickly and accurately identified abnormal lesions in Mr. Zhang's fundus and gave a predicted diagnosis result. In the diagnosis results, the system displays the types of fundus lesions that the patient may have and provides corresponding probability and confidence scores. Based on these results, Wenjie can judge the reliability of the diagnosis and further discuss treatment options with the doctor. Mr. Zhang obtained accurate diagnosis results through the AI-assisted fundus disease diagnosis system, and received further guidance and treatment suggestions from the doctor. 102_7_1.content: In Wenjie's community, Mr. Zhang, a volunteer who cares about community affairs, discovered the book 'Animal Liberation' that has recently attracted widespread attention in the media. He became interested in the ideas in the book and hoped to organize a community discussion about animal rights. He learned that Wenjie is an expert in cultural heritage management and believed that his knowledge and experience in the field of ethics could provide valuable support for this discussion. So, Mr. Zhang contacted Wenjie and invited him to be the host of the discussion event. Wenjie is very willing to participate in this event and give full play to his professional background to provide community residents with detailed interpretations and exchange of views on animal rights. He prepared a brief introduction and discussion outline on 'Animal Liberation' and combined his experience in the field of cultural heritage management to elaborate on the importance of animal rights to social development and cultural protection. On the day of the event, Wenjie appeared at the discussion site with his tall and strong appearance. His black hair and black eyes gave him a professional temperament. He used vivid language and practical cases, such as industrial breeding and experimental animal use, to introduce the content of the book 'Animal Liberation' and the author's views to the residents attending the meeting. He mentioned author Peter Bentham's criticism of the inhumane treatment of industrial farming, as well as his recommendations for promoting vegetarianism and organic farming. In addition, he shares relevant research and practical examples cited by Bentham in the book, such as Jacob Usher's behavioral ecology studies and Jane Goodkill's observations of chimpanzees. Wenjie emphasized the importance of animal rights for social progress and cultural protection, and encouraged residents to reflect on their attitudes and behaviors towards animals. He advocates respecting the rights of animals and calls on everyone to adopt a more humane way to treat animals in their daily lives. This discussion event received active participation and widespread appreciation from community residents. Wenjie's professional knowledge and in-depth interpretation made him a core figure in the event. After the event, community residents had a deeper understanding of animal rights issues and expressed that they would pay more attention to and respect the rights of animals in practical actions. Mr. Zhang expressed his sincere gratitude to Wenjie for his professionalism and active participation, and hoped that there would be more similar activities in the future to jointly promote the development and progress of the community.
102_7_1.summary: The protagonist Wenjie organizes a community discussion on animal rights issues

104_5_2.content: Natural Fresh Fruit Garden cooperated with Teacher Chen to organize a cooperative promotion event called 'Juice Healthy Life'. The event will be held on May 10, 2022 in a large shopping mall. As an expert in the field of education, Teacher Chen shared knowledge and experience related to healthy living at the event. He mentioned the juice products from Natural Fresh Orchard, emphasizing their nutritional value and health benefits. Teacher Chen also worked with representatives from Natural Fresh Fruit Garden to demonstrate to consumers how to use fresh fruits to make juice. They squeezed several fruits on site and demonstrated the production process and taste of the juice. Teacher Chen encouraged everyone to drink more fresh juice and integrate health into daily life. This cooperative promotion attracted the attention of many customers and increased the brand awareness and sales of Natural Fresh Orchard.

104_6_0.content: One day, when Jiang Jun was resting at home, his friendly neighbor Mr. Wang knocked on his door. Mr. Wang knew that Jiang Jun was interested in the field of maternal care, so he excitedly told Jiang Jun that he had recently learned about a high-end social club called 'Youmei Pregnant Mothers Private Club'. Mr. Wang learned that this club provided a series of professional maternity care services and also held various social activities. He thought this would be a very good opportunity for Jiang Jun. Mr. Wang introduced the advantages of the club to Jiang Jun in detail, including the Guomao Building, located in Chaoyang District, Beijing, with an area of 1,000 square meters and multiple exclusive nursing rooms and member rest areas. He also mentioned the club’s high-end nursing team, which is composed of obstetricians, nutritionists, masseurs and other professionals. Mr. Wang encouraged Jiang Jun to visit the club to learn more about maternity care and build a supportive community with other expectant mothers. Jiang Jun was very interested in this idea, and he decided to take time to visit the 'Youmei Pregnant Mother Private Meeting' to see if he could find some nursing knowledge and social resources that would be helpful to himself and others.

104_6_1.content: Jiang Jun is a 30-year-old male educator with the nickname 'Xiaojun'. He and his friendly neighbor Mr. Wang often participate in community activities together. One day, at a community event, Jiang Jun took the initiative to share his experience in building connections and improving professional competitiveness on LinkedIn. He walks you through how to create a profile, fill in your details, and expand your network by interacting with other industry professionals. Mr. Wang was interested in the information and asked some questions. Jiang Jun enthusiastically answered questions and shared his experience in building trust and credibility on LinkedIn. Mr. Wang expressed his gratitude and decided to try using LinkedIn to expand his professional network. Since then, Jiang Jun and Mr. Wang have had more common topics and exchanges in terms of career development.

104_7_0.content: Jiang Jun is an active member of the community and often organizes reading and outdoor activities. Recently, he collaborated with Aunt Zhang in the community to jointly plan an outdoor event with the theme of Mayan civilization. Events are planned for this weekend at a local park. Jiang Jun and Aunt Zhang jointly designed the content and process of the event. They arranged a lecture about the Mayan civilization and invited an expert to share about the history and culture of the Mayan civilization. After the lecture, participants will visit an exhibit displaying images and artifacts about the Mayan civilization. In order to increase interactivity, Jiang Jun also organized a fun competition on Mayan civilization, in which participants can win prizes by answering questions and completing tasks. In terms of outdoor activities, Jiang Jun and Aunt Zhang planned a hiking activity. Participants will travel through a natural scenic area, appreciate the beauty of nature, and learn knowledge related to the Mayan civilization. The event is designed to give community members a better understanding of the Mayan civilization and promote their interest in history and culture. Jiang Jun and Aunt Zhang hope to bring a fun and educational experience to the community through this event.

104_7_1.content: During this event, Jiang Jun prepared a series of selected books for community residents and placed them in the community library. Aunt Zhang is a person in the community who loves reading. She often comes to the library to borrow books. After learning that Jiang Jun organized this reading event, she came to participate excitedly. Aunt Zhang exchanged some questions about books with Jiang Jun and asked him for some reading experience. Jiang Jun enthusiastically shared his favorite book recommendations and reading experience with Aunt Zhang, and the two quickly established a good interaction. Aunt Zhang also recommended some of her favorite writers and books to Jiang Jun. The two have common interests in reading. This reading activity not only provides community residents with rich book resources, but also promotes communication among community residents. Jiang Jun and Aunt Zhang made new friends at this event and established a closer connection with each other.
104_7_1.summary: Jiang Jun organized a community reading activity, and Aunt Zhang actively participated

104_7_2.content: Jiang Jun is an active member of the community and often organizes reading and outdoor activities. On June 15, 2019, he organized a lecture on the history of mathematics, which involved Euclidean geometry. Aunt Zhang is a resident of the community who is keen on learning and is very interested in mathematics. After she heard that Jiang Jun would give this lecture, she looked forward to it and signed up. In the lecture, Jiang Jun introduced in detail the importance and influence of Euclidean geometry, especially the theorems and reasoning in 'Elements of Geometry'. He mentioned things like Pythagoras' theorem, Pi's reasoning, and the golden ratio. Aunt Zhang actively participated in the lecture, raised some questions, and had in-depth discussions with Jiang Jun. Jiang Jun gave Aunt Zhang good answers and inspiration with his rich educational leadership experience and love for mathematics. After the lecture, Aunt Zhang expressed great satisfaction with Jiang Jun’s explanation and expressed her hope to continue to participate in activities organized by Jiang Jun in the future. This lecture not only enriched Aunt Zhang’s mathematical knowledge, but also deepened her understanding and trust of Jiang Jun.

104_8_1.content: Jiang Jun met a stranger named Mr. Liu during his travels. Mr. Liu is a man in his 40s, tall and with a kind smile. Jiang Jun and Mr. Liu met by chance while having lunch at a local restaurant. The two sat at adjacent tables and started talking about travel. Jiang Jun told Mr. Liu that he was an educator and loved reading, traveling and outdoor sports. Mr. Liu was very interested in Jiang Jun's career and asked Jiang Jun many questions about education. Jiang Jun patiently answered Mr. Liu’s questions and shared with him the educational leadership award he had received and his experience of teaching in a primary and secondary school. Mr. Liu expressed his appreciation for Jiang Jun’s educational experience and enthusiasm, and told Jiang Jun that he was also an education enthusiast. He said that he used to be a teacher and is now retired, but he still pays attention to developments in the education field. Jiang Jun and Mr. Liu exchanged many insights and views on education during lunch, and their conversation was full of mutual learning and inspiration. After lunch, Jiang Jun and Mr. Liu exchanged contact information and agreed to communicate and share travel and education experiences again in the future. Their meeting made Jiang Jun feel lucky, and he realized that traveling can not only enjoy beautiful scenery, but also meet many interesting and talented people.
104_8_1.Theme: Jiang Jun and Mr. Liu’s travel experiences

106_0_0.content: One weekend, Kong Jun and his wife Kong Xue visited the photography exhibition 'Urban Beauty: Exploring the Charm of Night' by the famous photographer Li Feng. They saw many wonderful works in the exhibition, including photography of Shanghai night scenes. Kong Jun and Kong Xue were deeply attracted by Li Feng's shooting skills and artistic sense. They carefully observed each work and savored the unique charm and beauty of the city at night. Kong Jun and Kong Xue discussed the composition, color use and artistic conception in the work together, and they were both amazed by Li Feng's photography talent. After the exhibition, Kong Jun and Kong Xue were immersed in the world of art and developed a deeper interest in photography. They decided to follow Li Feng's example, integrate more artistic elements into their lives and work, and use lenses to record the beautiful moments in life.

106_0_1.content: As a couple, Kong Jun and Kong Xue participated in the promotion of the ecological restoration project in the Yarlung Zangbo River Basin in June 2019. As a computational mathematician, Kong Jun used his extensive knowledge and enthusiasm for studying mathematics to participate in the data analysis and model building of the project. He used mathematical methods to evaluate and predict the ecological environment of the watershed, providing a scientific basis for project decision-making. At the same time, Kong Xue, as Kong Jun’s wife, also actively participated in ecological protection publicity and education. She organized a series of environmental education activities, including publicizing the importance of ecological protection to local residents, and collaborated with local women to carry out handicraft making and other activities to improve local residents' awareness of ecological protection. Kong Jun and Kong Xue worked together to make positive contributions to the ecological restoration project of the Yarlung Zangbo River Basin and made important efforts to protect the ecological environment of the basin. Their dedication and efforts have not only had a positive impact on the ecological environment of the region, but also provided valuable experience and reference for ecological protection work in other similar regions.

106_1_0.content: Kong Jun and his college roommate Wang Ming talked about nature photography at a party. Kong Jun excitedly shared John Smith's photography with Wang Ming, especially his case of Coral Ocean Dance. He describes John's chance discovery of an enchanting ocean of coral reefs on an island in the South Pacific. John's works show the vitality and diversity of coral communities, with each piece of coral exuding brilliant colors such as gold, emerald green, and purple. He used ultra-wide-angle lenses to capture entire marine ecosystems, showing the symbiotic relationship between corals and fish. Kong Jun also specifically mentioned the underwater drone technology used by John, which showed the details of marine ecology from an overhead perspective. Kong Jun and Wang Ming admired John's works together and were shocked by the beauty and diversity of the ocean world. They all believe that John conveys a love for nature and a call for conservation through his photography.

After in-depth analysis and discussion, they decided to purchase the convertible bonds issued by China ABC Company to enjoy its stable fixed interest and obtain value-added opportunities through future conversion of stocks. 107_4_1.content: Zeng Juan is a civil law expert who often collaborates with her colleague Liu Qiang on various cases, including those related to the financial crisis. When dealing with these cases, Zeng Juan and Liu Qiang conducted an in-depth analysis of the formation of the U.S. real estate market bubble in 2008, the issuance of subprime loans, and the problems of financial institutions. They learned that many financial institutions, such as Citigroup, Merrill Lynch, and Bear Stearns, packaged high-risk subprime mortgages into mortgage-backed securities for trading. This financial instrument was widely circulated in the market, forming a huge financial derivatives product market. However, in 2007, the U.S. real estate market collapsed, subprime mortgage loans could not be repaid, and the subprime mortgage crisis quickly broke out. When Liu Qiang and Zeng Juan were handling these cases, they learned that Bear Stearns was the first financial institution to fail, and was later acquired by Merrill Lynch at a low price, and then by JPMorgan Chase. The subprime mortgage crisis affected Citigroup and Merrill Lynch, which had to seek financial support from the government. In order to avoid the collapse of the entire financial system, the U.S. government took emergency measures, such as implementing financial rescue plans. The global financial crisis spread rapidly, affecting economies around the world. Zeng Juan and Liu Qiang jointly analyzed the impact of the crisis on the global economy, including the collapse of the stock market, the bankruptcy of many companies, and the soaring unemployment rate. They are also concerned that many countries have adopted economic stimulus policies to stimulate economic growth. By handling these cases, Zeng Juan and Liu Qiang gained an in-depth understanding of the operation of financial markets and the importance of risk management, and also conducted research and analysis on the global financial regulatory system.

107_5_1.content: As a student, Zeng Juan is conducting experiments on palladium-catalyzed Suzuki coupling reaction. Her mentor Chen Ming personally guided her and hoped that she could successfully complete this important experiment. However, during the experiment, Zeng Juan encountered some problems. She used the Suzuki catalysts (2,2'-bipyridyl) 2PdCl2 and dichlorobis(2,2'-bipyridyl)palladium(II) with triphenylphosphine ligands and organic bromides as substrates. However, the reaction did not proceed successfully due to improper adjustment of experimental conditions. Zeng Juan felt very frustrated and disappointed, and she didn't know how to solve this problem. Fortunately, Chen Ming discovered the problem in time and guided Zeng Juan to adjust the reaction conditions and improve the experimental operations. Under Chen Ming's guidance, Zeng Juan re-ran the experiment and successfully completed the Suzuki coupling reaction to synthesize the target compound 2-phenylpyridine. The experience of this failed experiment made Zeng Juan deeply realize the importance of experimental design and operation, and had a positive impact on her future research in the field of chemistry.

107_5_2.content: In college, Zeng Juan studied the book 'The Fragility of Religious Justice' written by French sociologist LePierre under the guidance of her law tutor, the famous law professor Chen Ming. Published in 1996, this book explores the role of religion in the modern legal system and the influence of religious authority in judicial proceedings. Lepierre used the operation of the Sharia courts in France as an example to analyze the tension between Islamic justice and legal justice in French society. Zengjuan is very interested in this field because she is an expert in civil law and hopes to further expand her expertise by studying the interaction between religious justice and legal justice. Under the guidance of Chen Ming, she read a large number of relevant cases and legal documents, conducted in-depth research on the cases of Sharia courts dealing with issues such as marriage, divorce, property inheritance and civil disputes, and conducted a thorough study of the opposition between religious justice and legal justice. and reconciliation are discussed in depth. In her research, Zeng Juan also discovered the conflicts and cooperation between Sharia courts and the French legal system, and analyzed the supervision and restrictions of the power of Sharia courts by the government and legal institutions. Through this study, Zeng Juan further deepened her understanding of the importance and challenges of religious studies in the legal field.

111_0_2.content: On a weekend night, Song Xue and her sister Song Lin met at home to watch the controversial movie 'A Clockwork Orange.' As a professional in cultural heritage management, Song Xue has a strong interest in humanities and social issues in film works. As a musician, Song Lin is also full of curiosity about the presentation of music and culture in movies. Together, the two sisters discuss the film's plot, characters, and themes. They thought deeply about the conflict between free will and morality, as well as reflections on human nature and social morality. They discussed the complex protagonist of Alex and the dystopian atmosphere of society displayed in the film. Song Lin shared her insights on the relationship between music and violence. She believed that music, as an art form, was used to force Alex to perform violent acts in the movie, reflecting the distortion of human nature and the depravity of society. The two sisters also discussed the locations and buildings featured in the film, and were drawn to the film's specific portrayal of London and its surrounding areas. They mentioned the Korova Milk Bar, the Duke of New York Cinema, the headquarters of a gang of thieves, the Wormwood Scrubs Prison, and Alec St. George's Hospital, the rehabilitation center where St. George was sent. Both Song Xue and Song Lin expressed their appreciation for the diverse photography techniques and special effects used in the film. They believe that these technical techniques allow the audience to experience the story's deep thinking and sensory stimulation more deeply. The two sisters also discussed the film's controversy and impact. They mentioned that the film has been accused of being too extreme in its depiction of violence, and has even led to the imitation of violent incidents in society. The controversy sparked public discussion about censorship and free speech. They discussed the importance of the film as a deeply humanistic and social work that affects and reflects on the audience. Both sisters believe that 'A Clockwork Orange' is a thought-provoking movie that arouses the audience's attention to social ethics and individual psychology through its plot, characters and thoughts on morality and free will. They decided to continue researching and discussing the film in depth, and planned to participate in relevant academic seminars to share their views and insights with other researchers.

117_1_0.content: Bao Juan and Li Ming were good friends in college and still maintain close contact. The last time they met was at a party on May 12, 2022. At this gathering, they talked about the molar structure in the field of chemistry. One of the famous cases was the theory of the molar structure of benzene proposed by the German chemist Friedrich August Kekulé von Stradonitz. Bao Juan introduced the molecular structure of benzene and Kekulé's theory to Li Ming in detail. She explained that benzene is an organic compound composed of six carbon atoms and six hydrogen atoms, and Kekulé believes that the benzene molecule is composed of a cyclic carbon skeleton, in which carbon atoms are connected by single and double bonds. . This molar structure not only explains the molecular shape and chemical properties of benzene, but also provides chemists with ideas for exploring more cyclic organic compounds. Bao Juan and Li Ming exchanged their views and understandings with each other during the discussion, and gained a deeper understanding of the molar structure of benzene. This discussion gave them a more comprehensive understanding of the development and application of organic chemistry, and also enhanced their friendship and academic exchanges.
117_1_0.summary: Discuss the molar structure of benzene

117_1_1.content: Bao Juan and Li Ming are college classmates. Now they are meeting in a cafe to discuss the spherical surface theorem in topology. As a senior engineer at an Internet company, Li Ming has a strong interest in mathematics. Bao Juan introduced him to the origin and significance of the spherical surface theorem. Together they explored basic concepts in topology, such as topological spaces, spheres, and manifolds, and delved into the proof process of the through-sphere theorem. Li Ming also showed strong interest in the applications of reduction mapping and shear mapping. During the discussion, they also recalled their fond memories of attending various social events and traveling together during their college days. Bao Juan was proud of Li Ming's achievements in the Internet field and expressed the hope that they could continue to maintain friendship and explore more mysteries of mathematics and science together.

117_5_0.content: While in college, Bao Juan met Mr. Li Shiming, who was her mentor and academic advisor. Mr. Li Shiming gave great guidance and help to Bao Juan’s academic and career development. Under the careful guidance of Mr. Li Shiming, Bao Juan not only obtained a bachelor's degree in international business, but also conducted in-depth research in the field of education and learning. Together they often discuss new trends and innovative teaching methods in the field of education. In one of the discussions, they talked about the application of the 'Starry Spring and Autumn' textbook in Chinese primary and secondary school literature education. Bao Juan mentioned that 'Stars in Spring and Autumn' is a juvenile literary work created by the famous Chinese writer Yang Hongying and is widely used in Chinese teaching in junior high schools. Through a brand-new storyline, diverse teaching methods and innovative literary appreciation perspectives, this textbook successfully guides students to fully experience the treasures of ancient Chinese literature in literary education, and cultivates students' literary literacy and reading habits. Bao Juan also mentioned that the teaching content of 'Stars in Spring and Autumn' includes classic poetry, classical prose and novels in ancient Chinese literature, and involves many well-known ancient writers and works, such as Du Fu's masterpieces 'Ascend the High' and 'Deng Gao'. 'Spring Night Happy Rain', Liu Xiang's 'Chen She Family', etc. The selection of these classic works not only allows students to understand history and culture, but also cultivates their aesthetic ability and creativity. Li Shiming agreed with the application of the 'Stars in Spring and Autumn' teaching material, and discussed with Bao Juan the teaching methods and teaching activities in the teaching material. They believe that 'Stars in Spring and Autumn' guides students to analyze the ideas and values behind literary works through in-depth analysis of themes, characterizations, emotional descriptions and other elements in literary works, improves students' understanding of literary works, and cultivates their Literary appreciation ability. At the same time, they also affirmed the inspiring learning activities designed in the teaching materials, such as student writing, role playing and literary criticism, etc. These activities can improve students' practical application ability and creativity, and cultivate their critical thinking and expression skills. With the help of Li Shiming, Bao Juan integrated the application experience and teaching concepts of the 'Stars in Spring and Autumn' textbook into her international business consulting work, providing enterprises with diversified and highly interactive business training and cultural exchange programs.
117_5_0.summary: The application of the textbook 'Stars in Spring and Autumn' in literature education in primary and secondary schools in China

122_1_0.content: Researchers conducted an experiment called 'Brain Neural Mechanisms of Episodic Memory' in 2020. The experimental subject is a 25-year-old volunteer named Li Ming, who is a college student. First, the researchers used magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) technology to scan Li Ming's brain. Then, they designed a memory test and asked Li Ming to watch a movie plot. In this plot, there is a hero named Tom and a heroine named Lili, who spent a happy time in a park. Later, Li Ming conducted a learning task related to this plot. He was asked to recall what happened in the movie and write down the details. In the next few days, the researchers constantly reminded Li Ming to recall the plot and strengthened his memory in different ways. Finally, after a week of memory training, the researchers scanned Li Ming's brain again. The results showed that Li Ming's activity in memory-related areas such as the hippocampus, prefrontal cortex, and temporal cortex was significantly enhanced. This shows that after memory training, Li Ming's brain's neural mechanism has been optimized and improved when he memorized this plot. In addition, the researchers also found that Li Ming's working memory improved when he recalled the plot. Working memory is the human brain's ability to store and process information in a short period of time. Through training, Li Ming's working memory capacity increased significantly, and he was able to better understand and remember complex situational information. Through this case, we can see that learning and memory have clear neural mechanisms in the individual brain. Through systematic memory training, people can improve their learning and memory abilities. This is of great significance to students, professionals and the elderly. Of course, this case is just one example, and there are many other studies and experiments exploring the mysteries of learning and memory. I hope this case can help you gain a deeper understanding of learning and memory.

122_2_0.content: Cheng Hao and his romantic partner Zhang Ting participated in a scientific investigation project on changes in seismic activity and geophysical parameters during volcanic eruptions. This project is jointly implemented by the International Geological Society and multiple geological research institutions. The investigation area is located in Chile, South America. The main research object is the famous Chaiapoto volcano. As a geophysicist, Cheng Hao is responsible for conducting detailed surveys and geophysical measurements of the inspection area, while Zhang Ting, as a reporter, is responsible for recording the inspection process and conducting interviews and reports. They met at a medical seminar, admired each other and developed a deep relationship. The team participating in the expedition consisted of geophysicists, seismologists, geochemists and volcanologists, with a total of 20 members. Before the start of the project, the team conducted a detailed survey of the investigation area using geophysical methods, including geological and geomorphological surveys, geophysical measurements, and seismometer network layout. During the volcanic eruption, the expedition team conducted long-term field observations, and seismometers recorded hundreds of earthquake events. By analyzing the location and analysis of seismic events, researchers were able to determine the depth of volcanic activity, energy release and other parameters. At the same time, gravimeters and geomagnetometers observed crustal deformation and changes in the geomagnetic field around the volcano. Researchers also conducted volcanic eruption material collection and chemical analysis in order to study the volcano's eruption mechanism and the source of magma. The entire project lasted two years, and the research team finally reached a number of important conclusions, which provided a scientific basis for the prediction and monitoring of volcanic eruptions. Cheng Hao and Zhang Ting worked closely together on this project and went through the inspection and research process together, further deepening their relationship.

130_0_0.content: Chen Minghua is Chen Wei's father. He is a researcher with a background in environmental law.
